notes.title: Update 195 - Endless Arena
notes.content: [p]Hi all,[/p][p][/p][p]This update adds another Arena map, where the goal is to try and survive as long as possible.[/p][p]It contains achievements for surviving 20, 40 and 60 minutes. After 60 minutes the red guardian will appear as the final enemy.[/p][list][*][p]You unlock the map by completing the regular Arena map.[/p][/*][*][p]This is by far the most difficult map in the game, with attack waves being random. The best strategy is to stop levelling after you maxed all your equipment. Enemy health scales based on your level.[/p][/*][*][p]To get achievements you have to use the portal to exit after 20, 40 or 60 minutes.[/p][/*][*][p]Only the three Arena achievements can be gained, all other achievements are disabled.[/p][/*][*][p]The map is easier to beat as a group.[/p][/*][/list][p]Good luck and remember that we still intend to add Survivor Level 6 in the near future.[/p][p][/p][p]Till later,[/p][p]André[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Update 194 - Small fix to remove damage numbers that appear above Nokk
notes.content: The damage numbers above characters is a feature that's still in development and was accidentally included in the last update.

notes.title: Update 193: New map, characters, weapons and more
notes.content: [p]Hi all,[/p][p][/p][p]A new map called Beneath The Tides is now available. The entrance to the map is hidden, similar to maps like Corrupted Forest. There's 3 new playable characters, as well as new armor and weapons to unlock.[/p][list][*][p]The map contains a lot of surprising elements, like swordfish that glide across the screen to impale you! The boss is not all that he seems, be careful when confronting him.[/p][/*][*][p]Some of the new weapons include a Net that increases drop rate of the enemies caught. There's also the Aquatic Staff, that shoots water projectiles that split when enemies are hit. The Gold Anchor is a cursed weapon that keeps dropping on to enemies' heads. There are more weapons to discover.[/p][/*][*][p]A new player attribute, Gold Fever was added. It increases your damage by up to 100% if your attribute bonus is 100% and you have looted 5000 gold in-game. Having a lower attribute percentage or less gold scales it down.[/p][/*][*][p]A Magic Lockbox was added (it's not easy to find). It allows you to pick what artifact will appear in your first level up. This can be set per loadout.[/p][/*][*][p]A Spade artifact was added, which allows you to uncover buried treasure and gold.[/p][/*][*][p]The character selection view is now scrollable since all the characters won't fit on the screen anymore.[/p][/*][*][p]The Sickles weapon now strikes to the left and the right simultaneously.[/p][/*][*][p]The Poison Dagger's damage was increased. There's also a new dagger hidden inside the new map.[/p][/*][*][p]The 3rd guardian is no longer slowed by the Slime Cube weapon.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]A lot of hard work has gone into the map. Let us know if you enjoy it and come visit the Discord if you need help or advice.[/p][p][/p][p]Till later,[/p][p]André[/p]

notes.title: Update 192 - King Slime's secondary weapon and viewing loot in-game
notes.content: [p]Hi all,[/p][p][/p][p]Today's small update adds King Slime's secondary weapon, allows you to view the loot you've picked up  and fixes some bugs.[/p][list][*][p]The Slime Cube is a weapon the expands on hit and greatly slows down, damages and poisons enemies.[/p][/*][*][p]You can now see the loot you've picked up by clicking on your character's portrait in-game. Marbles and unlocked equipment can't be viewed here.[/p][/*][*][p]A bug that allowed players joining a game to move through locked doors has been fixed.[/p][/*][*][p]An intermittent bug that prevented a trading npc's list of goods from being visible has been fixed. This includes Think Tank's list.[/p][/*][*][p]The detailed description of a mob in the Bestiary and in-game had a missing line feed before the status effects.  This was fixed.[/p][/*][*][p]On the map selection screen, when you click on a map with a secondary entrance like Sunken Caverns, that entrance will be selected by default. You can still select the primary entrance if you want.[/p][/*][/list][p]Remember to unlock King Slime's weapon by playing with it and finding a gold chest.[/p][p]Till later,[/p][p]André[/p]

notes.title: Update 191 - Shuriken revamp and QoL
notes.content: [p]Hi all,[/p][p][/p][p]We've improved the Shuriken's damage and it's projectiles now spread out.[/p][list][*][p]Try the Shuriken with Tessa since it gets double damage during limit break. You can add an additional 3 Shuriken by using the Projectiles +1 aura.[/p][/*][*][p]You can now hide the "arrows" above followers by setting the option "Hide follower chevrons".[/p][/*][*][p]When viewing a player's attributes (click on their portrait in-game), you can hide the attributes that have a default bonus of 0%. This helps you find the attributes that are boosted.[/p][/*][*][p]A bug prevented the character's color from working in some instances. This was fixed.[/p][/*][/list][p]Try out the Shuriken, you'll be surprised by it's damage output, especially when used by Tessa.[/p][p][/p][p]Till later,[/p][p]André[/p]

notes.title: Update 190 - Belts with artifact pouches
notes.content: [p]Hi all,[/p][p][/p][p]This update adds belts for survivor level 4 and 5. The belts make it possible to equip more artifacts during play![/p][list][*][p]The Leather belt has one artifact pouch that allows you to equip an additional artifact during play. Survivor level 4 is required and it's sold by Chester, who is unlocked by defeating the boss in the Castle Keep map.[/p][/*][*][p]The Alien belt has two artifact pouches but requires survivor level 5 and you must own the Leather belt before getting the deal from Chester.[/p][/*][*][p]The movement speed of both dogs were increased. You can find them as followers in several maps.[/p][/*][*][p]There was a bug when counting the number of destroyed urns for the achievement "Vandal".[/p][/*][*][p]A bug allowed players to enter the mission "Protect the village" with followers. This was fixed.[/p][/*][/list][p]Remember to add more artifacts to your Loadout if you buy a belt. We will have to add more challenging maps since the extra artifact slots give players a significant boost![/p][p][/p][p]Till later,[/p][p]André[/p]

notes.title: Update 189 - Improving Mortimer's drain wand and Erin's bite
notes.content: [p]Hi all,[/p][p]Mortimer's Drain Wand excels at life drain, but it's damage was lacking so we decided to boost it by 40%. Erin's Bite can now infect enemies and cause Blood Bats or Blood Servants to spawn when they die.[/p][list][*][p]Mortimer's drain wand does 40% more damage.[/p][/*][*][p]Erin's secondary weapon, Bite, has a chance to infect enemies and if they die while infected, a blood bat or servant will spawn. The spawn disappears after ten seconds, but several of them can be active at once. This means that players have more weapons that spawns followers![/p][/*][*][p]Weapons now shoot projectiles at a rate that's evenly spread over their cooldown. So no more short bursts followed by long "reload" times.[/p][/*][*][p]Alien trees had a hitbox problem, which we fixed.[/p][/*][*][p]When a projectile like the trident moved outside the map, an error could occur, which didn't stop the game but probably caused lag. This was fixed.[/p][/*][*][p]We implemented "tile maps" to improve performance and memory use.[/p][/*][*][p]Technical changes we've introduced means that new maps can be up to 4000 times larger![/p][/*][*][p]Most of the "props" like trees are now spawned on clients, meaning there's less communication between the host and the players, resulting in a game that starts a lot faster.[/p][/*][*][p]On the Crystalizer screen, the "fill all" button and "break 10" tick box was swapped around since it makes more sense that way.[/p][/*][/list][p]The game should feel smoother overall since the tile maps definitely improves performance. We hope you enjoy the Bite weapon and Mortimer's increased damage.[/p][p][/p][p]Till later,[/p][p]André[/p]

notes.title: Update 188 - New mission and armor set
notes.content:
Hi all,

We've added a new mission to destroy the underground spawners that are still attacking the village. Note that while the "protect the village" mission is in progress, you won't be able to accept the new mission. It also requires you to complete that mission at least once.

[list]
[*]New mission "Stop the Siege" for survivor level 3 and higher.
[*]A new armor set is craftable from materials found in the mission.
[*]You can now sell all gems for 50 gold each, but keep some emeralds since they will be required to craft the new armor found in the mission.
[*]The first attack wave is now delayed by 40 seconds in the "Protect the Village" mission.
[*]Two new achievements were added, paving the way for survivor level 6 requirement of 125 achievements.
[*]The trees in the first map have more variations now.
[*]The marble drop rate has been lowered by 10% since it was possible to find close to 150 marbles in a single run.
[*]The DLC map isn't visible in the Bestiary's drop down anymore.
[*]The outsider tentacle's pull does not affect fire serpents anymore.
[/list]
We hope you enjoy the new mission. A tip to finding all the armor pieces in the shortest amount of time, is to die on purpose after you collect a piece from the imprisoned guardian.

Till later,
André

notes.title: Update 187 - Rebalance starting player experience
notes.content:
Hi all,

We made improvements for the starting player, which will also benefit existing players.

[list]
[*]Doubled the default Health Regen rate to 2%. Lycus and Peter gets 3%.
[*]In the Upgrade book, Health Regen can only be increased by an additional 1%.
[*]If you die and spectate from another player's point of view, the colors will not be grayed out. You will also be able to see hidden areas of the map if that player is positioned inside them.
[*]Weapons now unlock 33% faster.
[*]The Oil Flask found on the first map's damage was increased by 25%. This helps to unlock it faster.
[*]Players are now less likely to get stuck between trees because trees are now bigger and paths between them were blocked.
[*]Nokk's axe can now hit directly below him, so players won't be stuck inside rooms without being able to move down through enemies.
[*]The following melee weapons can now hit directly below the player: greataxe, waraxe, maul, pickaxe and frostbite.
[*]You can now join games only 10 minutes instead of 15 minutes into play. This is because the length of play was reduced to 20 minutes in the last update.
[*]In the character selection screen, only characters that reached over 100 levels during play will show their level reached. A message that inform the player that attributes are permanently increased by reaching level 100 or higher, will show on other characters.
[/list]
Why not select an unused profile and start fresh with Nokk and Ivar? Let us know if the changes help you progress faster.

Till later,
André

notes.title: Update 186 - No more 30 minute runs and critical hits can do 3x damage
notes.content:
Hi all,

This is quite a significant update, for all sessions are now 20 instead of 30 minutes. Exp requirements were lowered and material (including marble) drop rates were increased to compensate for the shorter session.

[list]
[*]Map modes are now 20 minutes and "rush" is 15 minutes.
[*]The exp requirement for levelling is now 20% less. Since missions have always been 20 minutes, this means that players can now reach higher levels in missions.
[*]Material and marble drop rate increased by 33%
[*]Gold heaps, bags and bars increased by roughly 50%
[*]Nokk's greataxe does 30% more damage when maxed.
[*]Boomerangs, familiar and water sprites have new movement curves that let them move faster but turn back slower. This results in more enemies hit at the aimed target.
[*]Critical hits now have a small chance to do 3x (instead of 2x) damage. When a critical hit takes place, a check is made by using half of the critical hit chance. If this succeeds, a "lethal hit" occurs instead.
[*]Small fixes were done to the map walls in Vermin Cave and Beyond the Portal.
[*]A tip was added about the player's movement speed affecting followers and pets.
[*]Summons now face in the same direction as the player when they appear.
[*]A red "paintbrush stroke" will appear behind upgrades when they are maxed in the upgrades book.
[*]When you use the "clear loadout" button, you have to confirm that this is your intention.
[/list]
We hope you enjoy the faster runs. Maybe that leaves time to kill the guardians more often.

Till later,
André

notes.title: Update 185 - Secondary weapon for Cain and Greatsword upgrade
notes.content:
Hi all,

This update adds the soulfire status effect for the revenant's weapon, a secondary weapon for Cain and a bunch of other things.
[list]
[*]Added soulfire status effect to the greatsword. It can be boosted with a red aura, bestiary bonus, the revenant's primary stat and the upgrades book.
[*]The survivor level 3 upgrades now include soulfire damage.
[*]The revenant's primary stat was changed from revives to soulfire damage.
[*]Cain has a secondary weapon at last. It opens a wormhole that lets through a tentacle that attacks nearby enemies. If you use it with Cain, you'll get the limit break damage bonus (since it's his secondary weapon).
[*]A "break 10" tick box was added to the crystalizer screen so players can break 10 marbles at a time.
[*]Stargazer has two status effects, but you only saw knockback's description when you clicked on any of the two. This was fixed.
[*]The character selection screen will now remember the loadout, bestiary bonus and potion tick when you open the tavern, auras, workshop or stables screens.
[*]Sometimes when a mission was activated in the workshop, the map selection screen showed map icons overwriting each other. This was fixed.
[*]Outlines were added to the focused icon on some screens, e.g. workshop, tavern and stables.
[*]Think Tank's menu at the 3d printer now shows "craft adventurer" instead of "hire adventurer".
[*]"max dmg" on the player's portrait has been changed to "max avg" since it's the maximum value reached by the average damage (dps). The damage also doesn't wrap at 100k anymore.
[*]Added a tip that explains critical damage.
[/list]
I hope you enjoy the changes and please leave a review for the game if you have not already done so.

Till later,
André

notes.title: Update 184 - Griffo will farm materials for a fee
notes.content:
Hi all,

When you have Griffo in the Workshop, he will offer to hunt for materials on the first 5 maps. To receive the materials he has to be fully rested.
[list]
[*]Players can now choose 1 of 5 pastel colour schemes for their summons. This changes the colour of the summoned skeletons, skeleton archers, vipers and fire serpents. The setting is in Options => Game.
[*]Improved the dynamite by making the projectile travel a little slower and further (it has to collide with an enemy to explode).
[*]If you unlock equipment from chests or by playing with them, they remained unlocked even if you used Esc to exit. Unfortunately the achievement was not gained, forcing you to play again with the same character (without using Esc).
Achievements for unlocking weapons and for completing maps are now checked, even if you use Esc.
[/list]
We hope you enjoy being able to set the colour of your summons.
Did the change to the marble drop rate improve the game for you? Let us know on Discord.

Till later,
André

notes.title: Update 183 - Marble drop rate changes and QoL
notes.content:
Hi all,

We decided that marbles should drop more often on lower exp levels. So instead of scaling with the player's level in-game, the marble drop rate is now 0.001 % per kill. It's still affected by the map's marble drop bonus, the game's difficulty setting and the character's drop rate bonuses.
[list]
[*]Marbles should now drop at roughly 1 per 1000 kills. Drop rate bonuses will affect the final outcome.
[*]When a player holding a lockpicks artifact (or owning the lockpicks aura) unlocks an exit, a message is sent to all players to inform them that the exit is now open.
[*]When searching the Chat Log, it's now possible to use "you found a" to list the materials you found. The bug was related to XML tags being used in the log entries.
[/list]
I will adjust the marble hunter's guide in the Steam Community to reflect the change.

Till later,
André

notes.title: Update 182 - New achievements and mini boss attack range
notes.content:
Hi all,

This update contains the following changes:
[list]
[*]Touch damage range for the mini bosses is reduced to be similar to the normal enemies. This includes the guardians and the grim reaper. So they have to be closer to be able to hit you. This change does not apply to ranged attacks.
[*]Two new achievements were added to help survivor level 1 players reach level 2 quicker.
[*]The "sell 10" button in the Stash made a louder sound than the "sell 1" button and this was fixed.
[/list]
Be sure to check out our "chat and play" video series. We are still uploading more episodes. https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PLH2JrIC7SXYY1twXQ-DH2tzaSeoHzHydK&si=t-dzjmpDcgBe5MMR


Till later,
André

notes.title: Update 181 - Steam achievement progress fix
notes.content:
Hi all,

The fix are for the achievements Vandal, Exterminator, Materialist and Marble Madness.

Before profiles were introduced, Steam checked your progress for certain achievements (e.g. Vandal) and automatically awarded the achievement. Since achievements are now earned per profile, a manual check has to be made to determine if a profile has earned them.

Please play a map and exit or die for the achievements to be processed and updated.

Till later,
André

notes.title: Update 180 - Host sets maximum survivor level requirement
notes.content:
Hi all,

This update contains the following changes:
[list]
[*]The host selects both the minimum AND maximum survivor level requirement of joining players. This option was added so that you can host a game with a new profile and prevent players with a high survivor level from carrying you.
[*]The Profiles update did not migrate some achievements correctly to your first profile. The affected achievements have progress (e.g. Vandal), so progress would be 0 while the value on Steam was much higher. This has been fixed.
[/list]
Now regarding our "let's play" series on YT. We have decided to start a new one that will including our voices. If you have not heard us talk, or are interested in what we have to say, check it out on our YT channel. We will post the first episode later today.

Till later,
André

notes.title: Update 179 - Profiles!
notes.content:
Hi all,

This update introduces profiles, which allow you to start a fresh profile (survivor level 1) while preserving you progress on your main profile.

When you open the game, your achievements and progress will be migrated to "Profile 1". There are 4 other profiles you can select, each starting at survivor level 1 with 0 achievements.
Note that profiles 2 to 5 will have the default game Options, which you can set according to your preference.
To help you keep track of the profile you are currently using, it's name is displayed on the main menu. You can also change it's name.

If any of the profiles unlock an Achievement, Steam will activate it for the account. The achievement won't be automatically given to all the other profiles. So it will still appear as not unlocked in those profiles.

Note that the "Reset Progress" option has been temporarily disabled. I will rework it's functionality and include the change in the next update.

Here as some of the possible uses for profiles:
[list]
[*]Letting family members use different profiles to keep progress separate.
[*]Starting again with friends who just bought the game.
[*]Using a low level profile to play with other new players.
[*]Starting a "let's play" video series, showing progress through the entire game, without losing you main profile's progress.
[/list]
I will be starting a low level profile so I hope to see you in the game.

Till later,
André

notes.title: Update 178 - Rebalance the Overgrowth Wand and increase player spawn protection
notes.content:
Hi all,

The Overgrowth Wand (Titania's secondary weapon) seemed a little weak so after extensive testing in a summons/follower build we are now happier with the tweaked values.
I also increased player invulnerability with 33% (from 3 to 4 seconds) when spawning in the game.

Till later,
André

notes.title: Update 177 - Titania's secondary weapon and QoL changes
notes.content:
Hi all,

This update focuses mostly on QoL but we also added Titania's secondary weapon, the Overgrowth wand.
[list]
[*]Added the Overgrowth wand. It can be found by Titania in a gold chest. It fires projectiles toward enemies, spawning mushroom and flower attackers that will despawn after a few seconds.
[*]The game now makes a backup of the player's save file when you exit the game. The backup file will be automatically used if the save file is damaged.
[*]A new map mode called "Death Wish" was added. It's only available for survivor level 5 players and only allows solo play. You cannot join someone that uses this mode. It increases the maximum number of ordinary enemies by 50%.
[*]The Bad Trip mode now has increased attacker spawn rate. Mini boss speed increase is lowered to 33%.
[*]In the Stables you can now search for the material drop that is boosted by pets. E.g. the Fawn boosts the drop rate of Deer Horn.
[*]In Guardian's Gate, after destroying the guardian portal, a message will appear that says you must exit using the portal at the starting area.
[*]In the Achievements screen, progress for some achievements, e.g. "Marble Madness" can now be seen when you click on the achievement.
[*]Added a navigation button to the Workshop "deals" screen that allows you to go back to the previous deal.
[*]The Sword knight suit and the Spear knight suit now has animations in the Bestiary.
[*]The bat mini boss hidden in the guano cave will now have an outline if the boss outline setting is ticked in Options.
[*]Removed the on-screen message that said "Guardians arrive after 30 minutes" in the map selection screen.
[/list]
I hope you enjoy these changes. Titania's weapon is definitely worth getting, especially for using in a summons build.

Till later,
André

notes.title: Update 176 - New mission, artifacts and other changes
notes.content:
Hi all,

We've added a mission for survivor level 3 or higher players that rewards you with an Elemental Amulet. Margie can craft several types of artifacts using the amulet and gems you provide. Each amulet increases a specific set of status effects' damage by over 100%.

[list]
[*]New mission "Protect the village" plays like a tower defence map with a few twists. You only have your primary weapon and cannot use your loadout. Instead you have to buy all equipment from villagers by trading enemy drops.
[*]Distance calculations for "touch" attacks by enemies have been adjusted. The effect is that they can attack easier since they don't have to align vertically or horizontally with the player.
[*]Path finding of mini bosses, bosses and followers have been improved and they will now move straight up or down if needed (they used to zig zag a lot).
[*]The Crimson King's mission always stayed "in progress". This has been fixed. The mission also didn't appear if you didn't own the boat. It will now show that the boat is required.
[*]Prisoners rescued in the Crimson King's mission will now leave a message.
[*]Margie can now craft several elemental amulets, using the drop from the Protect the Village mission.
[*]The left joystick and DPAD of the Xbox X/S/One controller is now polled for movement while playing. We plan to improve the controller configuration in a future update.
[/list]
Enjoy the new mission and please keep in mind that it's accessible from level 3 but intended to provide a challenge, even on later levels.
If you have time, please nominate Fantasy Survivors for the "Better with friends" Steam award or leave a review to improve the game's visibility.

Till later,
André

notes.title: Update 175 - Fix for adventurer unlocks and UI tweak
notes.content:
Hi all,

This is a small update that fixes the adventurers not being unlocked when playing solo on some maps/missions.
If you experienced this issue, please try and unlock them again.

The update also increases the size of the missions drop down list so that it doesn't wrap around when too many missions are displayed. This might still need tweaking so please let me know if this happens again.

Till later,
André

notes.title: Update 174 - New mission, artisan, pets and monster egg type
notes.content:
Hi all,

This update brings a lot of new content.
[list]
[*]New mission for survivor level 5 players that involves Crimson King. He will follow you into the mission and also reward you with something special.
[*]Titania is now also an artisan. She will grow flowers and mushrooms from the seeds and spores you give her. It requires fertilizer, which is hidden somewhere in Corrupted Forest.
[*]A hidden area in Corrupted Forest that has a strong mini boss and tough skeletal warriors that spawn instead of the usual attackers. Fertilizer can be harvested there.
[*]The flask weapons (e.g. fire bomb) will now first target enemies that don't have the status effect yet. Hand of Midas will also do this.
[*]6 new pets were added. Some of them can be obtained from Brumik, who will first need a special material to make batteries from. Power cores are simply to big to fit into a tiny mechanoid.
[*]The cost of changing the adventurer you hire has been lowered from 500 to 250 gold.
[*]In the stables you can now search on the attribute given by the pet (e.g. drop rate).
[*]A secret follower was added. We'll only say that one of the artisans can craft it.
[/list]
We hope you enjoy the new content.

Till later,
André

notes.title: Update 173 - Fix the spawn times in the Arena map
notes.content:
Hi all,

When testing the boss outline I set the spawn times for the Arena map low. This is now fixed.

Till later,
André

notes.title: Update 172 - Visibility of Mortimer's deals in the workshop
notes.content:
Hi all,

We decided to make all of Mortimer's deals visible without first owning the ingredients. You still need the minimum survivor level to see them. Also, the new armor's "hands" and "feet" names were swapped. This has been fixed.

Till later,
André

notes.title: Update 171 - New necromancer armor set and artifact
notes.content:
Hi all,

To celebrate our 5000 players milestone, we're releasing a bigger than usual update.
[list]
[*]New artifact crafted by Mortimer for survivor level 5 players. It works similar to the scroll of the dead but summons skeleton archers.
[*]New armor set also crafted by Mortimer for survivor level 5 players. It can fuse with the new artifact, is heavy armor, has the follower damage attribute and summons an additional skeleton archer when it fuses.
[*]You can now outline players and bosses using a setting in Options. For now, you cannot pick the color.
[*]You can disable fighting on the miner followers (both the dwarf and the mechanoid) if you want them to mine only. You don't need to hire them as followers to activate the setting when going to Sunken Caverns.
[*]Pets are now assigned per character.  Characters will start without a pet assigned to them and you can assign any pet to them.
[*]At the game over screen, each weapon now displays the percentage of damage it contributed to the total dps (damage per second). This is useful to see since some weapons do consistent damage but not high damage. The percentages for each weapon is rounded down so if you add them up you might get slightly below 100%
[*]The lobby icon (e.g. chest run or boss run) will now be defaulted according to the map chosen. You can still change it before starting the map.
[*]The annoying guards near the boat spawn point in Sunken Caverns have been removed.
[*]Fixed a bug in the Tips screen that prevented some tips from showing.
[/list]
Thanks for being the best gaming community we could hope for! You've inspired us to make the game what it is today.
Till later,
André

notes.title: Update 170 - Unlock boss and open chests can now be done at level 200
notes.content:
Hi all,

[list]
[*]Fixed level 200 preventing unlock of items or picking up the boss.
[*]On the game over screen, the weapons' and artifacts' levels are now visible.
[*]In the equipment inventory, an item's level is now placed either left or right so it's more visible.
[*]In the Shop, new items will now have a red dot to make them more visible. The dots disappear when you close the game.
[*]The Storm Gauntlet is now more effective since it will hit closer to you if there are no distant targets. Previously it didn't attack the guardian when it came close to catching you.
[*]Added a tip about the first chest you open while playing (it contains the best possible loot).
[*]All halflings will now be visible on the mini map (pink dots).
[*]"phantom" coins and exp is caused by network data corruption, but we added some checks to remove them. Please let us know if you still see them.
[/list]
Keep in mind that the Storm Gauntlet has a long cool down (2 seconds) so you still have to keep your distance from the 3rd guardian, especially during Nightmare or Bad Trip. Boosting you movement speed with the feather and other means is still a good strategy.

Till later,
André

notes.title: Update 169 - Some QoL changes to assist beginners
notes.content:
Hi all,

We are confident that these changes will make it easier for beginners to get started.
[list]
[*]Increased the base player movement speed by almost 10%. Lowered the effect of the Feather artifact to compensate for this.
[*]Reduced the time required to unlock weapons by 25%.
[*]Increased the Dragon Staff's fireball speed by 20%.
[*]In-game tips have a longer cooldown so they will be less overwhelming.
[*]The level up selections now use a bigger font size. Text will be easier to read. Remember you can also pause the game by pressing Esc (in solo mode).
[*]The progress bar that shows when Limit Break happens, is now more visible.
[*]If you are putting together a new Loadout in the Stash, the error message that says what's missing from it will now pop up. So it will be easier to see what is missing from the Loadout.
[*]The Fire Drake was a bit underwhelming in the "Beyond the Portal" mission, so we replaced it with the all new Rot Breather. We also placed it in the "Find Brumik's Mechanoid" mission. Be careful out there!
[/list]
Enjoy the changes and check out the Discord if you haven't done so yet.

Till later,
André

notes.title: Update 168 - Beginner pets give Gold Total buff
notes.content:
Hi all,

Since the beginner pets can be levelled but do not give buffs like the hatched pets, we've decided to give them all Gold Total 10% (at level 5). Previously only the scarab pet had this buff.

[list]
[*]Added Gold Total attribute buff to all beginner pets. It's 2% - 10% depending on the pet's level.
[*]When you view your equipment via the portrait in-game, you can now click on weapons to see their base stats. Weapons used by other players can also be viewed.
[*]You will now get the option to drop the Dimensional Key when all your equipment reaches max levels. This is similar to the options for the Rake and Lock Picks.
[*]The mission "Brumik's Mechanoid" now shows the Dimensional Key icon since it's required for the mission.
[*]The Flamer adventurer's description has been fixed to show "incinerate" instead of "oil fire".
[*]Mortimer's "Scroll of the Dead" deal now shows the Necronomicon's icon to indicate that it's required.
[*]A bug caused some maps to slow down as time proceeded, notably the mission "Brumik's Mechanoid". The bug was fixed.
[*]The Pitfiendling no longer has a mini boss skull on it's health bar.
[*]More mechanoid parts were added to the starting area in "Brumik's Mechanoid". Up to 10 parts can spawn. If you rescue the mechanoid you will get the reward but will need another Ascus to take the mission again, so instead you can farm all the parts you need and exit via the portal.
[*]Collision boxes for stumps were decreased so players can easily maneuver past them.
[/list]
Till later,
André

notes.title: Update 167 - New mission and followers for survivor level 5
notes.content:
Hi all,

In the new mission your objective is to pursue whoever re-opened the guardian portal. Capture the culprit and also make use of the mechanoid fabrication table to unlock 3 new mechanoid followers.
[list]
[*]New mission "Beyond the Portal" for survivor level 5 players. It requires the achievement "Destroy guardian portal" and you must also own the follower Think Tank.
[*]Use Think Tank to craft 3 new mechanoid followers inside the mission. You have to escape via an exit to unlock them. It needs blueprints that must be bought from Brumik.
[*]Defeat the Crimson King in the new mission and unlock him as an artisan. As an artisan we still plan to add some deals to him.
[*]Thorns damage was affected by the player's physical damage bonus. This has been fixed.
[*]Use correct indefinite article with enemy and character names ("a" vs "an").
[*]Followers and mini bosses now stop walking towards enemies that are already in attack range of their short range weapon. Mini bosses all have touch damage, so this shouldn't affect them.
[*]Fixed the starting time of day (usually morning) not being correctly applied.
[*]If a player's Steam name contained commas, it could not connect to other players. This was fixed.
[*]Added a few game tips.
[/list]
Keep in mind that the new mission is intended for end game so the difficulty is very high. Since a mission is only 20 minutes long, we suggest that you craft only 1 mechanoid before proceeding to the exit.

Till later,
André

notes.title: Update 166 - QoL update
notes.content:
Hi all,

The update contains the following:
[list]
[*]Lets mention the chat log viewer (in main menu) since I forgot to mention it in the last update. You can view the chat after playing but it will be overwritten the next time you play. It is also searchable so you can verify drops, etc. For privacy purposes it cannot be copied to the clipboard but you can obviously take screenshots.
[*]You can now search the bestiary for a material drop. e.g. "power core". If you clear the filter, remember to press enter.
[*]If you reach level 200 in-game, your portrait will get a gold border.
[*]In the join menu, the survivor level icon was not cleared and still appeared on empty lines. This has been fixed.
[*]In the join menu, the list of games could be duplicated if you spammed the refresh button. This has been fixed.
[*]The join mechanic (private or public) is now displayed at the bottom of the screen during play.
[/list]
Till later,
André

notes.title: Update 165 - Secondary weapon for Chimerus
notes.content:
Hi all,

We are still working on a new map but decided that's it's time to release an update.
[list]
[*]Added a secondary weapon for Chimerus, the playable character that can be unlocked in the Arena map. The weapon does magical damage and applies electrocute, which normally requires both water and shock. So now it's possible to slow the 3rd guardian with a single weapon.
[*]Increased both the damage and range of Hand of Midas by 33%.
[*]Reworded the descriptions of status effects to better describe the damage applied to players and enemies.
[*]The host can now set the minimum survivor level needed to join the game. It is indicated by a survivor level icon.
[*]Improved the AI of followers to better balance fighting and harvesting. This will never be "perfect" but I've been able to tweak it on several occasions.
[*]Jonas' deals are now visible even if you don't have all the ingredients.
[/list]
Just a reminder that you can find Chimerus' secondary weapon by opening a gold chest.

Till later,
André

notes.title: Update 164 - New mission and adventurer for survivor level 5
notes.content:
Hi all,

This update contains the following:
[list]
[*]A new deal at Brumik. He wants to craft a mechanoid to scout a dangerous location.
[*]Once Brumik has crafted the mechanoid, it fails to return and Zoltar offers a mission to find it. The mission can also be used to farm mechanoid parts.
[/list]
The salvaged mechanoid parts found in the mission will later be required by Brumik, so hold on to them. We are still deciding whether to give the rescued mechanoid scout a weapon.
Keep in mind that this mission has a very high difficulty.

Till later,
André

notes.title: Update 163 - Despawning slimes leave a status effect area that damages players
notes.content:
Hi all,

The change to the slime ball weapon introduced an issue where ownership of the status effect area left by the despawned slime is incorrect, causing it to damage players. The issue has been fixed.

Till later,
André

notes.title: Update 162 - QoL update
notes.content:
Hi all,

This week's update contains the following changes:
[list]
[*]The slime ball weapon (from Slime King) did not add damage from the slimes it spawned or their status effect puddles to it's visible damage. Although this was just a visibility issue, it's now clear that the weapon is one of the top damage dealing magical weapons.
[*]Time allowed for joining has been slightly decreased from 20 to 15 minutes for normal maps and from 15 to 10 minutes for missions or map modes like Rush and Grim Reaper.
[*]Summons and followers that only attack (no harvesting) will now return only 50% of the follow distance to the player. This allows them to fight longer instead of constantly running back and forth when they move too far away.
[*]The knock back effect of barrels sometimes caused a non-fatal error that might have affected performance. This happened when the fire serpents were knocked into a wall. This was fixed.
[*]Layout of the artisans in the workshop and adventurers in the tavern were improved (less scrolling).
[/list]
Till later,
André

notes.title: Update 161 - Update the player equipment view in the player portraits
notes.content:
Hi all,

The player equipment view in-game showed other players' equipment but the weapons contained your own enhancements instead of their enhancements. This has been fixed.

Till later,
André

notes.title: Update 160 - See other players' equipment in-game and weapon storing removed
notes.content:
Hi all,

This updates enables you to view other players' weapons, artifacts and armor by clicking on their portrait in-game.
[list]
[*]View other player's equipment via their portrait.
[*]We've added 2 more loadouts! You can rename them if you want.
[*]Removed the Store Weapon functionality since it's been useless since Loadouts were implemented. You will be refunded for the gold used to upgrade it in the Upgrade book. Previously stored weapons will now appear during play so you should remove them from your loadouts.
[*]You can now temporarily override the Difficulty setting every time you play. This is done in the character selection screen. Tip: Set the difficulty in Options to what you normally use and override it in character selection when necessary.
[*]If you click "Back" from the map selection screen, you will now return to the character selection screen and not the main menu.
[*]The map mode can speed up enemies, but the mine cart and boulders are already super fast so we decided to make them immune to it. Their health are still affected by the map mode. This also applies to the guardians in Guardian's Gate that try to reach your portal.
[*]The player indicators (arrows) above the beginner pets were not visible. This has been fixed.
[/list]
Till later,
André

notes.title: Update 159 - Beginner pets and new map mode
notes.content:
Hi all,

Griffo will now appear in the Workshop once he's unlocked and provides pets to Survivor level 2 players.
The full update contains the following:
[list]
[*]Adopt-a-Pet where Griffo requires proof that you are strong enough to adopt a pet. The Stables icon is now available from Survivor level 2. The beginner pets do not give Attribute buffs.
[*]The Hand of Midas will now have a small chance to turn the entire enemy into a gold statue. The statue can either be sold or given to Gerald to unlock a random Bestiary entry. The drop rate of the statues are very low and the Drop Rate attribute will not affect it.
[*]Nightmare map mode is now available from Survivor level 4 and the new mode, Bad Trip, is available from Survivor level 5. Enemies run even faster, spawn faster and have more health. Note that both modes also affect the health and movement speed of bosses.
[*]Characters that are unlocked now show what map they can be found in.
[*]Small UI improvements were made, e.g. the player's in-game portrait now glows when the mouse hovers over it. When looking at an armor's Set or Weight details, a note has been added to say that the values are totals. The weapon Enhancement screen mentions that the number is a percentage of the weapon's base damage. You cannot accidentally sell equipment from the Stash by double clicking anymore.
[/list]
I hope you enjoy unlocking and showing off your new pets. We tried to add pets that can be paired with characters.

Till Later,
André

notes.title: Update 158 - Alternative method to upgrade pets and more
notes.content:
Hi all,

This week's update contains the following:
[list]
[*]If you manage to unlock the zookeeper, he can craft pet food that levels up a pet. The ingredients are quite rare and he can only craft one serving before having to rest. The mission to find him starts with a hidden door in Castle Keep.
[*]It's now less expensive to re-roll auras. The cost was lowered from 200 to 100 gold.
[*]If you have all the pets of a specific egg type and they are all max levels, the egg cannot be placed (and wasted) anymore.
[*]When the Necromancer set fused with it's artifact, the damage numbers remained where the artifact used to be. This was fixed.
[*]The Fire Serpents artifact's damage was boosted by 25% and the projectiles can hit twice as many enemies.
[*]Stargazer not summons less meteors but the damage of the meteors were increased.
[*]Made the chimera boss' hurricane projectile more visible so players can dodge it more easily.
[*]Slightly improved the look of the scrollbar on a lot of screens.
[/list]
Till later,
André

notes.title: Update 157 - Chat filter and QoL
notes.content:
Hi all,

This week's update contains the following:
[list]
[*]The chat line has 2 icons. The first will show/hide the chat window (same as pressing "C"). The second toggles between showing all messages, only important messages and only player chat.
[*]When you re-roll an aura, you won't get the same one for 2 successive rolls. This makes it a little easier to get the aura you want.
[*]The Fire Serpents damage has been increased by 100%.
[*]When it's initial target dies, the water sprite, boomerangs and familiar now returns to the player instead of disappearing. This means they do a lot more damage, especially if the player runs through enemies.
[*]Enemy drops and harvested drops will now bounce when they appear.
[*]The second map, Field Crossing, has a "cloud shadows" effect.
[*]When clicking on a mission, the name was not correct.
[/list]
Till later,
André

notes.title: Update 156 - Adjustments to new mission
notes.content:
Hi all,

This update contains adjustments for the new mission.
[list]
[*]Guardians did not always appear.
[*]Mobs now drop the same amount of exp.
[*]Lowered the number of sucklers (mob).
[*]Some walls did not block the player.
[*]A few map tiles were changed.
[/list]
Till later,
André

notes.title: Update 155 - Mission for survivor level 4 players
notes.content:
Hi all,

[list]
[*]The new mission is optional and relies on the player finding an item in Castle Keep. It's for survivor level 4 and above.
[*]We've added an artifact that Gerald can craft, made from Dimensional Shards found in Forgotten Tomb.
[*]When a player selects a mission, the map's name in the lobby won't show a number anymore.
[*]We've also fixed a bug that prevented games being shown in the lobby. This happened when a player used "retry" and created a public game.
[*]When you play solo and a mob kills you, the name of the mob will be shown.
[/list]
The mission is something we started on the side, so we are now back to working on the new map.
A special shout out to the veterans that are helping new players find their feet. The game is picking up momentum and this motivates us to continue adding new content.

Till later,
André

notes.title: Update 154 - Lifesteal rebalance and QoL
notes.content:
Hi all,

This update brings an important change to Lifesteal. Because Lifesteal is so powerful, players rely on it to instantly heal them and don't keep an eye on their hp bar. After this update, melee players will have to use an additional source of lifesteal and the hp bar will again become relevant. To compensate we've made hp regen permanently scale with the max level a character reaches (like the other attributes). We've also increased the base health of all characters by 20% and increased the hp regen tick to 10 times a second.
[list]
[*]Reduce Lifesteal by 40% but increased attainable Health Regen and base health.
[*]Improved the AI of miners.
[*]UI change: The Stash now displays the Loadout buttons only when an item is selected. Various changes were made to simplify creating a Loadout.
[*]UI change: A character's Base Health is now displayed.
[*]UI change: Some pets showed "progress %" even though they attained level 5.
[*]UI change: The "intent" is now called the "lobby icon". Overlap with the Game Mode description was fixed.
[*]UI change: When you press Esc during the game, the wording in the popup window is different.
[*]UI change: The Game Tips screen now mentions the fact that it's displaying the in-game tips.
[/list]
Till later,
André

notes.title: Update 153 - Survivor level 5 upgrades
notes.content:
Hi all,

Finally some survivor level 5 upgrades, a fix for the duplicate player team colors and a lot more.
[list]
[*]Survivor level 5 upgrades added. They can be accessed from the Upgrade menu.
[*]Fixed: Clicking a full Crystalizer caused some lag.
[*]When you choose a map, you can now choose the "intent", e.g. chest run or boss run. The intent icon will be visible if you host a public game. This helps players to select the right loadout before joining.
[*]Fixed: A player sometimes joined with the same team color. We have also switched to colorblind-friendly colors.
[*]When you open the Stables, your current pet can immediately be returned without first clicking on it's icon.
[*]Fixed: Gaurdians that target your portal did not stop spawning after the gate was destroyed.
[*]Player's health bar in the portrait now refreshes at 10 times a second.
[*]The skeleton and viper summons now roam slightly further out before returning.
[*]Exp crystals won't be on top of other materials that drop anymore.
[*]Fixed: Some followers' weapons created a long trail behind them when teleporting back to the player.
[*]Various performance improvements were made.
[/list]
We are working on a new map and mission. More details will be given closer to their release.

Till later,
André

notes.title: Update 152 - DPS visible for summoning artifacts and more QoL
notes.content:
Hi all,

The update contains the following:
[list]
[*]The summoning artifacts will now show the DPS below them, similar to the weapons. DPS is the combined value for all creatures summoned by the artifact.
[*]On the Game Over screen, summoning artifacts will be listed along with the weapons so you can compare their max damage.
[*]You can now see the Base Stats of weapons by clicking on the Damage Type in the Stash/Shop.
[*]When you try to sell a weapon that's been enhanced (contains marbles), you will be asked to downgrade it first. This is to prevent accidental selling of enhanced weapons.
[*]A map can now limit the time allowed to join. Guardian's Gate is set to allow 5 minutes for players to join.
[*]Playable characters not yet unlocked will now show the map's name where they can be found.
[*]It was possible to click on the invisible Discord link from the main menu, from screens like Character Select and Tips.
[*]The Sentinel Star and Fire Serpents' attribute now states that leveling  them up decreases the cooldown.
[*]When the Grim Reaper map mode was selected for Sunken Caverns, it overlapped with the Entrance dropdown.
[*]Sometimes there were too many lights in the game, resulting in a player not having a light on them.
[*]The summoned skeleton's hit animation has been improved.
[/list]
I hope you enjoy the changes.

Till later,
André

notes.title: Update 151 - Achievement and QoL
notes.content:
Hi all,

Today's update contains the following:
[list]
[*]Increased the Drop Rate bonus of the Farmer set from 12% to 30%.
[*]Added an achievement for making a +30 weapon. This only registers after you finish a run.
[*]Pets now show the Egg Type they hatched from in their description.
[*]Fixed the Scroll of the Dead fusion with Necromancer set not increasing the number of summoned skeletons.
[*]Reduced the warlock boss (Cain) damage by 25%. Also decreased the cultist meteor damage by 15%. I advise the use of potions when you take on Forgotten Tomb. If your health is lowered by status effects, the boss will appear more deadly than it is.
[*]Increased the height of the player's name field on the portrait to accommodate some special characters. The player's level is now simply displayed as a number, in a larger font.
[*]Added a full stop after each tip in the Tips screen.
[/list]
Till later,
André

notes.title: Update 150 - Achievements and Lobby distance
notes.content:
Hi all,

The update contains the following changes:
[list]
[*]Prison Break achievement now works in multiplayer even when the prisoners are following different players.
[*]Added achievements for 2 missions: destroy liches and stop the rampaging mushroom. These achievements are "offline" and not on Steam.
[*]The Join screen was only showing lobbies of games in the same region as the player. It now shows lobbies from anywhere in the world.
[/list]
You will now see more games to join, but the drawback is that some games could lag because of the distance between players. If you find that you joined a game that is lagging a lot, disconnect using Esc in the game. Note that your progress will not be saved when you do this.

Till later,
André

notes.title: Update 149 - Achievement and smoother movement of other players
notes.content:
Hi all,

This week's update contains the following:
[list]
[*]Smoother movement of other players in your game.
[*]Added achievement for Survivor Level 5. For now the achievement is stored offline so it won't be visible in Steam.
[/list]
Work on the DLC is continuing and we'll release more detail on it soon. Please support [url=https://www.twitch.tv/etup]Etup[/url] as he's been streaming up to survivor level 3. It won't be long before he reaches level 4.

Till later,
André

notes.title: Update 148 - Enable "sell 10" in Stash
notes.content:
Hi all,

This is just to enable the "sell 10" button in the Stash. The item description area has become larger due to the artifacts being displayed in the weapon description. This has led to the description area overlapping with the "sell 10" button.

Till later,
André

notes.title: Update 147 - 5 player support and more QoL changes
notes.content:
Hi all,

The game finally supports 5 players. We've tested it and found no issues but I think it will impact performance on lower end systems, especially if you created the game. Players that create a 5 player game should ideally have a fast pc and low latency Internet.

[olist]
[*]Up to 5 players can now play together. This means that auras scale up to 30% if all players have the same aura (10% + 5% + 5% + 5% + 5%). Enemies get 50% more hp for every player that joins so for 5 players they will have 300% their normal hp.
[*]Adjusted marble drop rates to give slightly more at player levels 1 - 175 but maintain the same drop rate from 175 - 200. So there won't be a huge spike in marble drops around level 200 anymore.
[*]Slightly increased Gem Cutting success rate for marbles and gems.
[*]Wooden and silver chests now give slightly more gold.
[*]You can now enhance a weapon inside the Loadout instead of just in the Stash view.
[*]You active pet is now displayed next to your character in the Character Selection screen.
[*]In the Shop and Stash, in weapon descriptions, all artifacts are now listed that have an effect on the weapon.
[*]When you level up in-game and hover the mouse over an artifact choice, current weapons will be highlighted if they are affected by the artifact. It will help you decide whether to select an artifact.
[*]Fixed a bug where the water sprite sometimes jumped in from outside the player's view.
[*]Made several network changes so less data is sent. This was done to make 5 player support possible.
[*]Enemies will now keep their pose when dying and not revert to the "idle" pose.
[/olist]
Enjoy the 5 player support and let us know if you experience any issues. We found that players sometimes have the same color but will investigate it over the weekend. This is a cosmetic error and won't cause other problems.

Till later,
André

notes.title: Update 146 - Player directional arrows and exit arrow
notes.content:
Hi all,

The directional arrows around the player was not visible anymore. The exit sign was also affected.
This change places them on top of the darkness effect so they will always be visible.
I have also tweaked the "dissolve effect" when enemies are defeated.

Till later,
André

notes.title: Update 145 - Drop Rate increases from Pets and other changes
notes.content:
Hi all,

We've made pets more valuable by letting them increase the Drop Rate of materials. A pet usually affects enemies from the same type, e.g. a Bat pet will increase the drop rate of Bat Wings. This makes it worth getting a wide range of pets.

[list]
[*]Pets increase the drop rates of materials shown in their descriptions. Their level determines the amount, which ranges from 20 to 100%.
[*]Pets are now sorted by name in the Stables.
[*]In the Character Selection screen you can now see what will be unlocked when you reach the next Survivor Level.
[*]The arrows above players and their followers will now be easier to spot since they are not affected by light levels.
[*]Some special characters will now be visible in players' names and chat messages. Not all characters are supported.
[*]It was possible to make a Loadout's name too big to fit in the dropdown list.
[*]The boss' hp bar that appears at the top of the screen will now momentarily glow.
[*]Various performance increases were made.
[/list]
Happy farming with the help of the pets and remember that Skinner also increases drop rates of enemies it hits.

Till later,
André

notes.title: Update 144 - Harvesting performance increases
notes.content:
Hi all,

On maps where your followers can harvest plants or mine crystals, there was a performance impact when someone joined the game or when you harvested a large number of resources. This has been resolved and we decided that it was worth releasing the update since it has a big impact on the game's performance.

Till later,
André

notes.title: Update 143 - Cursed Sands equipment unlocks
notes.content:
Hi all,

We fixed a data problem on the Cursed Sands map. It prevented equipment associated with the map, e.g. the Sage armor set, from being unlocked.

Till later,
André

notes.title: Update 142 - Networking improvements
notes.content:
Hi all,

We've replaced the obstacle update system and it helps to relieve the lag seen in maps like Sunken Caverns. It sometimes prevented new players from joining.

Till later,
André

notes.title: Update 141 - New map and playable character
notes.content:
Hi all,

We've completed a new map that can be unlocked from Cursed Sands. The update also lets your pet level while it accompanies you.
[list]
[*]Using the Lockpicks artifact, you can unlock the entrance to the Forgotten Tomb in Cursed Sands.
[*]The Forgotten Tomb has a playable character, a warlock that uses a weapon called Decay.
[*]A Bestiary reward and 4 achievements were added. These achievements are offline (not on Steam) until we migrate them all to Steam in the future.
[*]A pet that's not boarding in the Stable, will now level every hour of combined playing time. Pets will still level if you hatch the same type from a monster egg.
[*]If you click on a monster in the Bestiary, it will now show you what maps it can be found in.
[*]If you click Tips in the main menu, you can now browse and search through all the in-game tips.
[*]Game Options => Audio Falloff Distance let's you indicate how far positional audio can be heard. If you set it low, you won't hear attack sounds from other players unless they are right next to you.
[*]A Loadout can now be cleared in the Stash with a single click.
[*]The oil slime was removed from the Slime Ball weapon, since it can make an oil puddle that prevents the 3rd guardian from getting wet and slowing when electrocuted.
[*]A monster's walk animation  now switches to it's idle animation if it's slowed down a lot.
[*]Scroll speed (via the mouse wheel) was increased in the shop, stash, bestiary and stables.
[*]The Tanglebow and Frostbow were bugged. The cooldown upgrade made them slower instead of faster.
[*]Harvesting/mining efficiency was increased again. Please try it in the Sunken Caverns.
[/list]
We hope you enjoy the new map. We found it quite challenging.

Till later,
André

notes.title: Update 140 - Common mushrooms drop spores
notes.content:
Hi all,

Since spores are needed to incubate the monster eggs, we've changed the common mushrooms so they have a chance to drop it. Previously you could only find them in the "Destroy Fungi" mission.
[list]
[*]White, Red and Glow mushrooms in the cave areas will have a 15% chance to drop Spores.
[*]During chatting, if you press Esc to stop chatting, it would also open the Exit game menu.
[*]In the Workshop, the crafting details for the Founder Shield were shown to players who did not buy the game during early access.
[/list]
If you have time, please contribute to the [url=https://fantasysurvivors.fandom.com/wiki/Fantasy_Survivors_Wiki]Fantasy Survivors Wiki[/url]. This will help new players find their feet.

Till later,
André

notes.title: Update 139 - Grim Reaper mode changes
notes.content:
Hi all,

The update contains the following:
[list]
[*]Grim Reaper map mode is shortened to 20 minutes. The grim reaper's health is lowered by 20%. Have fun farming it for marbles, but remember to bring the Feather artifact.
[*]Fixed a bug in Grim Reaper mode that prevented marbles from dropping. This only happened in Forest Dungeon.
[*]The Luminous Shroom pet had the wrong walking animation.
[*]the "Master Crafted" and "Grandmaster Crafted" achievements only looked for specific marbles in the weapon instead of looking at the weapon's enhancement total.
[*]The "Potion Taster" and "Potion Toaster" descriptions were changed to mention that it needs to be done in a single run.
[*]When you level up and you can choose an artifact, the Attribute's description will be visible. Example: Regenerate Health - Regenerates your health over time.
[*]Changed the animation of the opening Treasure Chest (a chest that drops gold bars) so that it does not use the Gold Chests's last image.
[/list]
Thank you for letting us know when you find problems in the game. Without your help they could go unnoticed.

Till later,
André

notes.title: Update 138 - Minimum of one gold chest in map
notes.content:
Hi all,

The update contains the following changes:
[list]
[*]For maps that have chests, at least one chest will be a gold chest. To increase your chances of getting the character from it, pick it up first. This is per player and just breaking a chest won't count as your first chest.
[*]The exit key has a higher chance of dropping in the first map.
[*]The incubator won't give you a pet that's already level 5 and cannot be levelled up more.
[*]You won't see messages of materials being picked up by other players except marbles, eggs and materials needed to complete a mission. So a lot less clutter in the chat window.
[/list]
I hope you enjoy the changes. If you haven't already, check out the "progression guide" topic in the Steam Community.

Till later,
André

notes.title: Update 137 - Enemy's material drops for all players
notes.content:
Hi all,

Enemy materials (e.g. frog legs) used to be instanced so only the player that kills it get the drop.
Now the drop will be given to all players, meaning you can help each other farm for drops.
This is similar to how harvested drops like crystals and plants work.
[list]
[*]Farming for scarce drops is now easier since all players get the drop. If all players use the Drop Rate aura, it stacks as follows: 10%+ 5% for each additional player. You can increase your Drop Rate by setting the game's difficulty in Options. The Red Orc follower increases the drop rate of an enemy it hits.
[*]Fixed a rare problem where the player does not get his loadout in the game.
[*]Fixed a problem with the in-game Bestiary.
[/list]
Enemy material drop rates are not affected by the map difficulty or your player's level in-game.
However, both of these do affect marble drop rates.
Also keep in mind that marble drops are instanced.

Till later,
André

notes.title: Update 136 - Changes to map Exits
notes.content:
Hi all,

There's a small change to the requirements for completing a map and getting the achievement.
[list]
[*]Exits that are not opened by the Exit Key won't be seen as a requirement to complete the map.
[*]An in-game tip was added to tell the player that the Lockpicks artifact is required to open some exits. Note that the Lockpicks Aura does the same thing.
[*]All Map Modes except "Normal" now require a minimum of Survivor Level 2. This is needed since the first map can now be completed early on.
[/list]
Till later,
André

notes.title: Update 135 - Sliding movement and Exit key
notes.content:
Hi all,

Just a small update to decrease sliding movement caused by Steam's controller emulation. We do want a small amount of sliding to remain.
I also fixed the issue of some mini bosses still dropping an Exit key when the map does not require it.

Till later,
André

notes.title: Update 134 - Full release update
notes.content:
Hi all,

It's full release day and the update contains "partial Xbox controller support", which means that you have to use Steam's controller binding to configure your controller.
[url=https://youtu.be/0WhnA6EisvI]Here[/url] is a video that explains the basics.

[list]
[*]Tested with Xbox S controller. Steam controller binding must be set up. After that, inside the game, Options => Controls must be used to bind the keys to the controller buttons. Movement is bound by default to analogue joystick 1.
[*]You won't find the Exit Key in maps where it's not needed anymore.
[*]Pause and Portrait key binds were added so you can view a player's attributes and pause the game with the keyboard/controller.
[*]Once you've crafted Obsidian Tools, gem crafting success is 30% instead of 20%, so less crystal powder and more marbles and gems.
[*]The Mountain Wyvern's picture in the Bestiary was fixed.
[*]The pet Water Slime's picture in the Stable was fixed.
[*]Mined crystals will only block movement for 1 second instead of 4 seconds after being mined. This results in faster mining.
[*]The in-game messages "you found X gold" and "limit break, your weapons do.." are now only shown in the message window and not at the bottom of the screen.
[*]Material drops are now light grey dots on the mini map.
[*]Made some improvements to the menus.
[/list]
Thank you for supporting us during Early Access, we will continue to update the game and bring you more content.

Till later,
André

notes.title: Update 133 - Large QoL update and easter eggs
notes.content:
Hi all,

We have a large QoL update for you:
[list]
[*]The player's health is now regenerated 4 times a second instead of twice a second. This is done so the health bar on the player portrait is more responsive and to make it easier to survive damage with a high Health Regen.
[*]In the Stash and Shop, when filtering the view to armor only, the armor sets are now together and sorted by name.
[*]A full set of armor will now get gold trimmed slots to indicate the set is complete when you play.
[*]The Monster Egg drop rate was increased by 25%
[*]The Slime Walls in the Infested Sewer map now has health bars so you can see how much damage you're doing.
[*]The Bestiary will now only display an enemy if you killed at least one of them. 
[*]If you opened a chest and the content stayed there, waiting for the other players to find, it did not look like a chest on the mini map. This was fixed.
[*]When you are killed and use a Revive, enemies are now knocked back, even guardians! The same applies when a dead player is rescued. Some enemies like the mine cart, slime walls and guardian invaders won't be affected.
[*]When you teleport in Guardian's Gate or the Vermin Cave mission, enemies at the target location are now knocked back.
[*]In the Achievements screen, when there are one or more achievements available to be claimed, the Claim All button will immediately be visible.
[*]All followers and adventurers will now teleport back to you if they are more than twice the distance they would normally walk back to you. This is only checked when they start walking back.
[*]There will be a red icon on the Tavern to indicate that there are new adventurers. This will happen for all players since the amount has to be saved and then compared every time the screen is viewed.
[*]The slimes spawned by the Slime Ball weapon were a little blurry. This has been fixed by not scaling them so they appear slightly smaller now.
[*]The message "a prisoner has armed itself" appeared when mechanoids were rescued in the Sunken Caverns. This has been fixed.
[*]In Guardian's Gate, some large brimstone rocks left a big invisible obstacle after being mined. This was fixed.
[*]An enemy in Guardian's Gate called the Damned got a slight health boost and is now immune to Bleed.
[*]Two easter eggs were included, but don't ask us for details.
[/list]
Just a reminder that we are 4 days from the game's full release on 30 April! The Early Access exclusive item won't be available to players who purchase the game AFTER 30 APRIL 2024.

Till later,
André

notes.title: Update 132 - Early Access exclusive item
notes.content:
Hi all,

An exclusive item is available to everyone who's bought the game as well as those that buy it before 1 May. It is our way of thanking you for supporting us during Early Access. The game has grown thanks to everyone's contributions and suggestions.

[list]
[*]The exclusive artifact, Founder Shield gives 20% damage absorption. It is crafted from the Buckler. In order to craft it you need survivor level 2 and the playable character Brumik.
[*]Gem cutting now has a 40% chance of giving a Legendary Marble from the Legendary Crystal. This has been increased from 33%.
[*]Players that were rescued after the 3rd guardian was defeated, didn't get the movement speed buff. This was fixed.
[*]The first chest content you pick up on any map will give you the best possible item from that chest. This has been increased to the first 2 chests for the Forest Dungeon and Sewers maps.
[*]Harvested plants (using the Herbalist) now leave their stems, which disappear after a few seconds. There's also a harvesting sound.
[*]Pets were incorrectly using the player's loot distance, instead of their own. This was fixed.
[/list]
Please inform anyone that plans to buy the game of the Founder Shield. It's only available till the end of the month.

Till Later,
André

notes.title: Update 131 - Obsidian Pickaxe and QoL changes
notes.content:
Hi all,

This update is important for end game crystal mining and also includes a few small changes.
[list]
[*]Survivor level 5 players can pay Brumik to craft the Obsidian Pickaxe from obsidian shards. It allows helpers to improve their crystal mining. The chance for a crystal to drop will be 85% instead of the default 60%. It does not apply to crystal shard miners.
[*]The main menu was modified. Let us know if you like the new look.
[*]We fixed animations for some pets.
[*]The cave floor tiles that connected with water was modified.
[/list]
Till later,
André

notes.title: Update 130 - Pets that loot and provide buffs
notes.content:
Hi all,

Pets are finally here! Their eggs have been dropping for quite some time so you just need to get Seed Oil from Cassie and head to the Stash where you can incubate them. You need to have Survivor Level 3 to use it.
There are 3 incubators that use seed oil to warm up the eggs. Different amounts of oil are required depending on the rarity of the egg. Eggs take from 10 minutes for Common ones, to 50 minutes for Wyvern eggs.
To help players, we've increased the egg drop rate by 5 times!
[list]
[*]Incubators in the Stash hatch eggs over time. Once a pet hatches, you can find it in the Stables, on the Character Selection screen.
[*]If you hatch a duplicate pet, your existing pet levels up. Pets can reach level 5. The Attribute buff becomes more effective with each level. E.g. a pet that gives Movement Speed will go from 2% to 10% at level 5.
[*]For now players can only use one pet at a time, but we plan to allow more than one at a later date. When you return a pet to the stables, a boarding fee applies.
[*]Pets differ in their movement speed, attribute buff and loot distance. They loot exp crystals and materials but cannot attack.
[*]For Survivor Level 5 players, we've added a new map mode called Nightmare. Enemies run twice as fast, spawn twice as fast and have double their normal health!
[*]We've made the Skeleton Scroll part of the Necromancer armor set!
[*]Armor details were not displaying correctly for the Necromancer set but has been updated.
[*]We've weakened the red, yellow and blue attacking goblins (not the guards) in the Rescue Jeweller mission. This makes the mission a little easier.
[*]The Arena Champion achievement now unlocks if you get 25 Arena coins in a single run (instead of 20).
[*]Tiles that form the cave walls and cave floor are now more varied.
[*]Fixed in-game message to indicate that both Primary and Secondary weapons do double damage with Limit Break.
[*]When a new artisan appears for the first time, the Workshop icon will have a red indicator.
[*]Some Status Effects will happen more regularly. E.g. "wet" and "shock" combines to form "electrocute". Previously there was a 12 second cooldown before "wet" worked again on the same enemy. Now the game removes the cooldown since "wet" and "shock" were cancelled by turning into "electrocute". You will see significant increase in damage for some weapons.
[/list]
Have fun hatching the pets. Remember that Unique and Legendary eggs do not drop yet.

Till later,
André

notes.title: Update 129 - QOL changes
notes.content:
Hi all,

The update contains the following:
[list]
[*]Increased the chance of getting a legendary (red) marble from gem cutting from 20% to 33%. This is due to obsidian tools being used.
[*]The sulfuric acid pool is now see-through.
[*]The obsidian tools dialog has been fixed to say 100 instead of 50 obsidian shards.
[/list]
Gem Rifts is still on sale (50% off) and we just need 2 more reviews. Please post a review if you have the game. Ten reviews will display "positive" next to the game's name.

Till later,
André

notes.title: Update 128 - Sulfuric acid potion and npc trading distance
notes.content:
Hi all,

This update contains a few small changes.
[list]
[*]The sulfuric acid splash potion now creates sulfuric instead of regular acid pools.
[*]In Guardian's Gate you can now trade with npc's over a slightly longer distance. This allows you to trade while waiting to teleport at the towers.
[/list]
Tip: The secret method for finding more brimstone at Guardian's Gate is to dig for it.

Til later,
André

notes.title: Update 127 - New map Guardian's Gate with new artifact, armor and weapon
notes.content:
Hi all,

Guardian's Gate is the final map before the game will exit Early Access. There will still be one or two quality of life updates before the event.
[list]
[*]New map Guardian's Gate is unique since you have to prevent guardian "invaders" from reaching your fort and touching the portal. They spawn at a Guardian Portal, which can be destroyed. You can destroy towers, post guards, hire attackers and harvest resources.
[*]Use Brimstone to hire attackers or guards from npc traders. You can also keep it for the new craftable weapon, the "Sulfuric Acid Splash Potion".
[*]There's currently no potion that protects you from sulfuric acid, so watch out for enemies that use it.
[*]Guardian Invaders will try to reach the portal where you entered. If they succeed, the game is lost.
[*]On the winding path that leads to the Guardian Portal, Obsidian Towers spawn enemies to protect themselves. If you destroy certain towers, an npc trader will sell you guards and a fast travel door will open, in case you want to go back to the fort.
[*]Two new armor sets were added.
[*]The attributes are now correctly displayed when you click on the armor set's name inside the Stash.
[*]A new weapon, the Crossbow was added. One bolt can penetrate several enemies.
[*]A new artifact, "Summon Fire Serpents" was added. The serpents have a cooldown, which decreases as you level it up.
[*]The Crimson Shoes, part of the Firestarter armor set, now create a fire puddle below the player at regular intervals.
[*]It is now possible for players to work together to get the Destroy 20 Sarcophagi achievement.
[*]Similar to the Rake, you will have an option to drop the Lockpicks when you've levelled all your equipment.
[*]The Bestiary reward for unlocking all enemies on the map is Soulfire Damage +25%
[*]Fixed some animations for projectiles and special effects that were cut short, e.g. the eagle axes' vortex.
[*]On the character selection screen, when exiting the Tavern or Workshop, the Barbarian isn't selected by default anymore.
[*]Lowered the spawn from the hole traps in the Arena map. Spawn can even be zero if there are already too many enemies in play.
[*]Changed the player spawn buff to give both 100% absorb damage and 100% regenerate health. This is only active for 3 seconds upon entering the map.
[*]Underlined clickable descriptions in the Stash and Shop to show that they can be clicked.
[*]The Guardian invaders and all map bosses (not mini bosses) will now show a big health bar at the top of the screen.
[*]The Obsidian Tools now require 100 obsidian shards to craft. This was done because the new map contains an abundance of obsidian.
[*]The 3rd Guardian (red) will now always drop an Exit Key.
[*]When the revenant and Mort reaches level 200, they will get an extra Revive on their primary attribute. If you already have level 200 on these characters, please level them to 200 again to unlock it. 
[*]If you stand too far away from resources, your followers will not harvest them anymore. This is to keep their focus on your position.
[*]The enemies that spawn from the pit traps in the Arena now give less exp.
[*]The skull icon on mini boss health bars now disappear immediately when they die.
[/list]
There's 3 ways of finding Brimstone, but 1 of them is secret :-)
A good strategy is to hire a few guards at the starting fort, then destroy obsidian towers so you can place more guards at their positions. If a guardian invader passes you and you are not sure whether your guards can kill it, use a fast travel door to return to the fort and protect the portal.

Till later,
André

notes.title: Update 126 - Arena map with new unlockable character!
notes.content:
Hi all,

If you go north from the portal in Field Crossing, and equip the Lockpicks artifact, you can finally unlock the Arena map at the portcullis exit! The arena contains waves with up to 3 mini bosses attacking you simultaneously. The boss will appear in the last wave, followed by Guardians, who are accompanied by Guardian Spawn!

[list]
[*]New map, The Arena, unlocked from Field Crossing by using the Lockpicks. The map is extremely difficult, so don't expect to complete it on your first try. Blood Moon mode is enabled by default and potions cannot be taken into the Arena!
[*]New playable character, afflicted with the chimera curse.
[*]The mini bosses in the Arena sometimes drop Arena Coins, which sell for a high price and are also used as a crafting ingredient.
[*]Margie the jeweller will craft an artifact if you give her enough Arena Coins. This requires Survivor Level 4.
[*]Added 4 new achievements to make it easier to get Survivor Level 5.
[*]In the Workshop and the Tavern you will now see the portrait outlines of all characters that can be unlocked.
[*]Marble drop rate slightly lowered and loot material drop rate slightly increased.
[*]Map description when selecting a mission will now correctly show the enemy health and damage multipliers.
[*]Added the "does not stack" hint to auras in the aura selection screen.
[*]Fixed a problem that caused loot materials to stop dropping after the player reached level 150.
[*]In Infested Sewer, we slightly increased the distance you have to be from slime eggs before they hatch.
[*]Made the networking more robust.
[/list]
I hope you enjoy the new playable character. His weapon is worth the effort, so try and defeat him in the Arena!

Till later,
André

notes.title: Update 125 - Map exits that require the exit key only works with the lock picks
notes.content:
Hi all,

This update fixes a problem where map exits don't work with the exit key, but only with the lock picks.

Till later,
André

notes.title: Update 124 - Survivor level 5, 4th Aura line, new marble and new mission
notes.content:
Hi all,

This update contains a lot of content for high level players, but we've also added a difficulty setting, which increases your drop rate.
[list]
[*]Both the Lock Picks artifact and the Lockpicking aura can now open the exit! This is useful in case you cannot find the exit key.
[*]The Game Difficulty setting is in the Options menu and ranges from Normal to Insane. Use it with care!
[*]For Survivor level 5 you need 100 achievements (there are 105). If you have enough achievements but it's not upgraded, enter a map and die or use an exit so the game can re-calculate your Survivor level.
[*]Mobrik can craft Legendary marbles, but requires the Obsidian Tools crafted by Brumik. Once you are level 5, visit Brumik to see the ingredients.
[*]There's a new mission for Survivor level 5 players, which will give you the required resource type. The next map we release will also contain this resource so don't despair if it's scarce.
[*]The 4th Aura line is available for Survivor level 5 players. We plan to add a few more attributes since the lines normally have 10 to choose from.
[/list]
I hope you enjoy the changes and be careful of increasing the Game Difficulty, especially when playing on the harder maps.

Till later,
André

notes.title: Update 123 - Max damage per weapon shown and Bestiary progress visible in-game
notes.content:
Hi all,

The title was too short to include that there's also a new weapon added. The Oil Fire Bomb, crafted by Brumik, requires the Oil Flask and the Fire Bomb. It causes the oil fire effect on enemies and does more damage than the Fire Bomb.

[list]
