[*]See your Bestiary unlock progress while you kill enemies. Progress is only shown when an enemy is killed. It's visible by clicking on your portrait and using the Bestiary icon at the top. 
[*]At Game Over, you will see your weapons and the maximum damage achieved by each weapon. Status effect damage is included. Remember that a primary weapon is enhanced during limit breaks, so it's damage will be higher when playing with the matching character.
[*]The Oil Fire Bomb can be crafted from Survivor Level 2, when the Workshop becomes available and if you found Brumik.
[*]The zoologist will now say something when he's rescued.
[*]Followers and adventurers will react to harvestable and rescuable targets 33% further away. They will also stop short of the player when returning. Teleporting still moves them on top of the player.
[*]In the Bestiary, "all maps" have been replaced by "all monsters". The zoologist in the Workshop can now unlock a monster in "all monsters", making it possible to unlock monsters not listed under a specific map.
[/list]
Till Later,
André

notes.title: Update 122 - Survivor Level 2 get's Workshop access and more!
notes.content:
Hi all,

We've decided to allow access to the Workshop for Survivor Level 2 players and added several new recipes.
[list]
[*]Added three Survivor Level 2 weapon recipes to Brumik, who appears in the Workshop when you unlock him in the Caves map.
[*]Added one Survivor Level 3 weapon recipe to Brumik.
[*]All the new weapons inflict a status effect.
[*]There are now 5 bows in the game!
[/list]
All of the recipes require that you own a specific weapon (buy in Shop). The marbles in these weapons will be destroyed but Dust is obtained from the marbles and you can buy the weapons again. The newly created weapon will also appear in the Shop.
I hope you are able to use the new weapons in your builds. The Trident might be a good replacement for the Javelin.

Till later,
André

notes.title: Update 121: A zoologist can help complete the Bestiary for a fee
notes.content:
Hi all,

A zoologist can now be rescued and will appear in the Workshop. For a fee, he will complete a random entry for a specific map in your Bestiary.
[list]
[*]Added Gerald the zoologist that needs to be rescued from a place with many books.
[*]Found in the Workshop, Gerald can complete an entry in your Bestiary. His fee is 2500 (2000 with the discount) so it should only be used as a last resort.
[*]It is rare but possible for an error to cause a "broken" public session to stay open until the host closes Steam. Trying to join the session causes the game to hang on the "Joining" screen. Now, after 10 seconds, the game will give up and report that it's unable to join.
[*]The host and clients will now stop communicating after sending/receiving the final "game over" data.
[*]Changed the description of the "Gold Total" attribute to mention that it's only applied at the end of the game.
[/list]
Till later,
André

notes.title: Update 120: Lower Bestiary unlock requirements for first 2 enemies in map
notes.content:
Hi all,

The update contains the following.
[list]
[*]Lowered the Bestiary completion requirement of the first 2 enemies on every map (by 33% and 50%).
[*]Reworked the "game over" updates to the player's save file. Instead of saving the file after every update, e.g. amount of gold, marbles, loot materials, etc. it only saves once after updating everything.
[/list]
Till later,
André

notes.title: Update 119: Crafted adventurer and Spears auto aim
notes.content:
Hi all,

A lot of players have asked us to change the spears to auto aim. I resisted for a long time since I believed the mechanic had it's place, but since there are enough other weapons for players that like to rush in, I decided to try it. Spears (including the steam lance), now look like they will shine when combined with ranged weapons, where you brush past enemies, hoping to kill them before you actually touch them.
[list]
[*]Changed spears and steam lance to use auto aim.
[*]Added a deal to Brumik for Survivor level 4 players. He will craft a mechanoid that can be hired as an adventurer. The mechanoid uses the Hand of Midas to produce gold coins from enemies. It does less damage than the other combat adventurers.
[*]Loadouts now require at least 3, not 2 weapons.
[/list]
I hope everyone enjoys the new content. I'm sure there will be less complaints about Hilda now.
All the blessings of the new year.

Till later,
André

notes.title: Update 118: Esme's trades and QoL improvements
notes.content:
Hi all,

Esme finally offers some deals. Here is the full list of changes in the update.
[list]
[*]Added loot material deals for Esme. Go visit her in the Workshop.
[*]The Enhance Weapon interface can now be used to destroy marbles currently in a weapon. This has the same effect as selling and buying back the weapon to remove the marbles.
[*]The Loadout and Bestiary buff is now remembered per character. This is only stored if you select the character and continue to the next screen.
[*]In the Shop, Stash, Tavern and Workshop, you can now use double-click instead of selecting then clicking a button. This was only added where a single function is possible.
[*]Changed wording so players know that hiring an adventure is a once-off cost.
[*]Changed description of the Guildmaster to make it clearer that the Missions map is used to play missions.
[*]The Discord invite on the Main Menu will now open the link if you click it.
[/list]
Esme's deals will reward you with at least double the cost of the ingredients. There's a number of new players trying the game over the festive season. Use the Join button to see public games and help them if you can.

Till later,
André

notes.title: Update 117: Weapon for Sewers, Boat and Workshop UI improvements
notes.content:
Hi all,
We are excited to announce the improved Workshop user interface.
[olist]
[*]The artisans will now show the material icons and the amount you own.
[*]Added a new map-specific weapon to Sewers (same to Infested Sewer). It is a torch that can be used as a club and it sets enemies on fire. It increases your light radius too.
[*]Brumik is willing to sell the boat he abandoned in the Sunken Caverns. Why not visit him and find out?
[*]Players's kills are now added together for unlocking the Bestiary. So it's worth teaming up to complete it.
[*]The Stargazer now has a minimum attack range, so it won't cause meteors to fall exactly on top of the player.
[*]Mushrooms in the Destroy fungi mission now don't drop boar pelts anymore.
[*]If you joined a game and all players die, you cannot use Retry anymore. Retry is meant for the player that hosts the game, since we are slowly adding parameters to the session that only the host may have unlocked.
[/olist]
Check out Gem Rifts, our previous game. It's currently on sale at 50% off.

Till later,
André

notes.title: Update 116: New weapon for Cursed Sands map
notes.content:
Hi all,

We've added another map-specific weapon to the Cursed Sands map. It will be a great help with clearing the mummy and scorpion spawners.
[olist]
[*]Added Stargazer weapon (magical) to Cursed Sands.
[*]Improved comments on the level up choices, informing players that the weapon will slowly unlock during play. The comment will also tell you if the weapon was found on the map instead of your loadout.
[*]Removed the two chests at the bottom of the Cursed Sands map. We noticed that low level players could easily grab them, ignoring the rest of the map.
[*]The weapon icons will now show unlock progress in green instead of grey, making it more obvious that you are unlocking them.
[/olist]
We are planning a small update before Christmas, adding a seasonal item somewhere in the game.
Reviews increase the visibility of the game in Steam so please help us out and leave a review.
Till later,
André

notes.title: Update 115: Improve performance for players joining and bestiary requirements
notes.content:
Hi all,

This small update contains the following:
[list]
[*]The lag that's noticeable for some players when joining a game, especially the new mission maps, has been greatly reduced.
[*]Unlock requirements for the first enemy that spawns in a map has been lowered by another 40%
[/list]
Till later,
André

notes.title: Update 114: New mission and offline achievements
notes.content:
Hi all,

Today's update let's you go on a mushroom hunt. We were planning on making the mushroom a playable character, but that will have to wait for a future map.
[list]
[*]Added a new mission for players that are survivor level 3 or higher. Hunt a dangerous mushroom and bring back it's loot. You have to survive or the mission fails, even though you keep the loot.
[*]Changed the "rescue jeweller" mission to be repeatable.
[*]Added some achievements that are stored in the save file and not on Steam. They are only visible in the game. To get the achievements, even if you have the character/equipment/map unlocked, you have to repeat the process by entering a map and leaving through the portal or exit. For the level 100 achievement you will have to reach level 100 again.
[*]100 gold is now awarded per achievement.
[*]On the character selection screen we fixed the words that were wrapping in the bestiary drop down box.
[*]The bestiary entry for "Giant Rat" was in black. This has been fixed.
[*]Fixed a bug that only happened when you died without killing any enemies.
[/list]
The new mission is 100% playable, but needs some performance tuning, so you might see a few bugs when joining someone playing the mission. We will enhance the map's performance (remove some stumps and mushrooms) and include it in the next update.

Till later,
André

notes.title: Update 113: Fixes and QOL changes
notes.content:
Hi all,

This small update contains the following:
[list]
[*]Lowered some of the Bestiary unlock requirements.
[*]We are not including the correct indefinite article when describing loot drops, "seeds" instead of "a seeds" and "an azure flower" instead of "a azure flower. Some items might not be corrected, e.g. marbles.
[*]For the "destroy liches" mission, we fixed some incorrect directions to the portal.
[*]All players are now notified when you find a monster egg, not just the player finding it.
[/list]
We are moving closer to our full release from Early Access. This will happen some time early next year.
Till later,
André

notes.title: Update 112 - Bestiary with rewards and a new playable character
notes.content:
Hi all,

We have some interesting new content, which reveals more about the enemies found in the game.
[list]
[*]The Bestiary contains detailed information about enemies you defeat. Each entry is slowly revealed as you rack up the kills.
[*]The Bestiary shows regular spawning enemies and guard types that spawn when you enter their domain. Mini bosses, bosses, guardians and a few others are not included.
[*]When you unlock all the enemies on a map, the Bestiary rewards you with an Attribute Bonus, e.g. Movement Speed +10%. The bonus must be selected on the Character Selection screen, just before you start playing. Only one bonus can be used at a time.
[*]Brumik offers a new deal to players that are Survivor Level 4. It is a new playable character with interesting weapons. As usual, he requires some rare drops.
[*]Monster eggs now drop from all regular spawning enemies. They are extremely rare so start collecting them until we complete the feature.
[*]Limit break has been enhanced with Soulfire. When it triggers, surrounding enemies start burning with blue flames. The effect is most useful at lower player levels. Position yourself well to engulf as many enemies as you can.
[*]Fixed a problem with the mission progress icon appearing outside of mission maps.
[*]Increased the number of enemies that drop metal fragments.
[/list]
Go ahead and have a look at the Attribute Bonuses you can unlock with the Bestiary. Some of them will be invaluable.

Till later,
André

notes.title: Update 110: Fix for joining players that are not currently in a mission
notes.content:
Hi all,

This update fixes an issue where the game hangs while joining another player if the player is not doing a mission.

Till later,
André

notes.title: Update 109 - Guildmaster's missions and new artisan
notes.content:
Hi all,

We've added missions, which are simple maps that use the Rush mode. Once you have Survivor Level 3, you can find the guildmaster in the Workshop. He has two missions, one to rescue a villager and one to destroy liches in the local cemetery.
[list]
[*]Added missions, which are given in the Workshop. A mission uses one of several possible map layouts. Some missions are repeatable.
[*]A new artisan, who crafts jewellery (artifacts) was added.
[*]If any player finds an adventurer or artisan, it will be unlocked for all players in the same session.
[*]Improved the behaviour of adventurers that harvest materials. They are more focused on harvesting/fighting and wander around less.
[*]Some new artifacts can be unlocked.
[*]Status effects normally disappear when an enemy dies, making it difficult to see if your weapon creates any status effects. For this reason, some of the effects now stay on the dying enemy.
[*]If all players died, some players' portraits didn't change to skulls. This was fixed.
[/list]
We hope you enjoy the missions. They can be challenging, so don't expect to beat them the first time you try. Please review the game if you have not already done so. It increases the game's visibility on Steam.

Till later,
André

notes.title: Update 108 - Rename loadouts, magnet pickup and other QOL changes
notes.content:
Hi all,

We have made the following QOL changes:
[list]
[*]You can now rename all loadouts except "Stash". The name has a limit of 8 characters.
[*]A new consumable, the item magnet, now drops from broken clay pots. It works like a super charged Rake for 5 seconds, pulling all loot towards you. It's circular range is a full screen's width.
[*]You can now sell potions. This is to ensure that the achievement "Potion toaster" can be more easily achieved by selling all normal potions.
[*]You cannot unlock the map boss' character by defeating the third guardian anymore.
[*]The character selection screen now informs you of hidden features you still need to unlock, e.g. the Tavern or Workshop.
[*]After defeating the 3rd guardian, a message will inform you that enemies have stopped spawning.
[*]There was a very small chance that "future damage" could kill or hurt you directly after reviving. This type of damage comes from unavoidable projectiles that have a delayed effect. This was fixed.
[*]You can now claim all unclaimed Achievement rewards (gold) by clicking on one of them and selecting "claim all".
[*]Some in-game tips were added.
[*]We've added a sound effect for when another player joins your game.
[*]The hireling Skinner now does more damage and causes loot to drop at an even higher rate.
[*]Mini bosses are now more visible on the mini map.
[/list]
I hope you enjoy these quality of life updates. Please review our game if you have not already done so. It boosts the game's visibility on Steam.

Till later,
André

notes.title: Update 107: New artifact and adventurer, Skinner the red orc
notes.content:
Hi all,

We've added an adventurer to be rescued as well as an artifact (it has several parts) to Infested Sewer. Note that you need Survivor Level 4 to buy the new artifact.
[list]
[*]New artifact that is made from parts given to Brumik. Requires Survivor Level 4. The parts are somewhere in the Infested Sewer.
[*]A new adventurer, Skinner the red orc can be rescued in the Infested Sewer. He has a very useful ability.
[*]The error "unknown error when trying to connect" is now replaced with the correct error message.
[*]A hotkey (default = C) to hide/show the chat window.
[*]A hotkey (default = T) to hide/show the game tips.
[*]The weapon's Status Effect details clickable in the Shop/Stash were improved.
[*]There are now in-game messages to track a weapon being unlocked.
[*]In Grim Reaper map mode, unique marbles drops are slightly decreased and gold bars increased.
[*]Small bugfixes were applied.
[/list]
I hope you find the new artifact and the adventurer useful. I don't want to reveal too much about them in the update notes, except to say that the artifact can be a life saver.

Till later,
André

notes.title: Update 106 - Status Effect detail in Stash and Shop
notes.content:
Hi all,

This small update contains the following:
[list]
[*]A weapon's Status Effect and Status Area Effect can be viewed by clicking on it in the Stash or Shop. This also shows the Status Effect interactions.
[*]When you defeat the 3rd guardian, every player gets a 100% movement speed bonus calculated on the character's base movement speed. If your character is currently faster, it won't be slowed down.
[/list]
Till later,
André

notes.title: Update 105 - Select a set of equipment before you play (Loadouts)
notes.content:
Hi all,

We've added Loadouts, which allows you to preconfigure 5 sets of equipment (6 if you count the Stash as well).
[list]
[*]Set up Loadouts from the Stash by clicking on equipment then clicking on a Loadout button.
[*]View Loadouts by clicking the filter button at the top to remove items or copy items to other Loadouts.
[*]Only valid loadouts can be selected to play with (a loadout will be RED in the Stash if it's not valid).
[*]If you sell or store equipment, one or more Loadouts may become invalid.
[*]The same equipment may be present in more than one Loadout.
[*]The Retry function will remember what Loadout you used.
[/list]
It's now easier to swap equipment for tasks such as gold farming or exp farming. Your Stash can now contain all your equipment, without burdening you down while playing.
We've added only 5 Loadouts for now and it's not possible to rename them yet.

Till later,
André

notes.title: Update 104 - Fix issue with Slime King
notes.content:
Hi all,

There's an issue where the slimes that spawn from Slime King's weapon is seen as followers. So the game tries to send data about 100's of followers to each client, causing an error. The symptoms is the game not saving at the end of a run when the Slime King is used. This has now been fixed.

Till later,
André

notes.title: Update 103 - New map and playable character
notes.content:
Hi all,

Time to go back to the Sewers and clean them out once and for all!
[list]
[*]New map, Infested Sewers can be unlocked by equipping the Lockpicks while standing next to the wooden gates in the Sewer map.
[*]Defeat the boss in the new map to unlock a playable character with a unique weapon.
[*]In the Audio Options menu you can now disable the menu's music.
[*]Most of the followers and hirelings now have sound effects when they attack.
[*]Immovable mobs like the sarcophagus caused status effects to appear at the bottom left of the map. This was fixed.
[/list]
Final thoughts... you might want to take some potions with you while exploring the Infested Sewers.

Till later,
André

notes.title: Update 102 - Chests dropping gold bars for all instead of just level 200 players
notes.content:
Hi all,

This update fixes the issue where chests drop gold bars instead of giving the level up choices for ALL players instead of just level 200 players. 

Till later,
André

notes.title: Update 101: Auto gold bag and better health regen
notes.content:
Hi all,

A lot of players have asked for the option to automatically take gold bags once all equipment has been upgraded.
[list]
[*]Automatically choose the gold bag as level up choice (set by player).
[*]Health now regenerates every half second, resulting in smoother healing (used to be every second).
[*]Added a smoke effect to the blunderbuss attack.
[*]Sometimes the player's level at the top didn't match the level shown in the portrait.
[*]You are now informed when you exceed a character's maximum level reached.
[*]Increased the player portrait refresh rates to half a second.
[*]The text on the Game Over screen glitched when OK was clicked.
[*]A weapon's description now says whether it has critical damage (in Shop and Stash).
[*]Added a few more in-game tips.
[*]Slightly increased the Pickaxe weapon's critical chance by 5%.
[/list]
Shout outs to everyone who's been streaming the game. We really appreciate your efforts.
Why not come and chat with us on the Revolt Discord server? https://discord.gg/nsVgZyQa

Till later,
André

notes.title: Update 100 - QOL and Networking improvements
notes.content:
Hi all,

Since you can look forward to many more updates, I've decided not to hold out on "update #100".

[list]
[*]Improved networking on the host. It not handles more messages per tick, meaning that clients are less likely to lag. During our tests we experienced almost no lag.
[*]If you reach Level 200 and open a chest, it will now drop a Gold Bar instead of not giving anything.
[*]Character's Levels are now visible next to their Attributes. You will have to reach the level during gameplay for it to be registered/increased.
[*]During the Game Over period, less network data is now sent between host and clients.
[/list]
I hope you enjoy update #100! Multiplayer sessions of Grim Reaper should now see less lag or almost no lag.

Till later,
André

notes.title: Update 99 - Grim Reaper map mode and Blunderbuss weapon
notes.content:
Hi all,

Here are the changes included in today's update:
[list]
[*]A new map mode, Grim Reaper, was added. The mini bosses are Grim Reapers that speed up as you level and buffs surrounding enemies. They drop gold bars, marbles (including the rainbow marble) and the exit key.
[*]The Blunderbuss is available from Adventurer level 3 onwards, when the Workshop becomes available. You need to have Brumik the dwarf plus all the ingredients he wants. Note that the equipment he needs must be purchased, in other words in your Stash!
[*]You can now spectate other players while you're waiting to be revived. Just click on a player's portrait to see their game view.
[*]The Tavern and Workshop buttons are now visible without having to first click on a character.
[*]All characters, even those you've not unlocked, are now displayed in the selection screen. This is to give new players an idea of how many characters are in the game.
[*]The spike traps in Cursed Sands will now slow you down as well.
[*]Summons, followers and hirelings now have the same chances as the player of finding loot materials. They still can't find marbles though.
[*]In the Stash, the materials are now sorted by name.
[*]There's now a selection box around clicked items in the Shop.
[*]Fixed Hand of Midas, cyclone staff and necronomicon's prices.
[*]Sometimes the special drop option wasn't given when you maxed all your equipment's levels. This is now fixed.
[/list]
I hope you enjoy running from the Grim Reaper! I suggest hunting it on the first map, since it has the lowest enemy health and damage multiplier. The Feather artifact will also come in handy.
Maybe you should pick up the Blunderbuss to help thin out the buffed enemies first?

Till later,
André

notes.title: Update 98 - New map weapon and achievements
notes.content:
Hi all,

We've added another map-specific weapon to Cursed Sands. Without spoiling the surprise, let's just say you can loot significantly more gold when using it.
[list]
[*]Added a new weapon, Hand of Midas, to Cursed Sands.
[*]Removed the Frost bow from Cursed Sands.
[*]Added 8 more achievements, making the total achievements equal 100! Unfortunately Steam won't allow us to go over 100 without seeing more sales and player engagement.
[*]Fixed the Dynamite not causing the shatter status effect when hitting frozen enemies.
[/list]
When you pick up gold coins generated by the Midas Touch effect, you won't see a message appear in the chat window.
We have not fully tested the potential of the Hand of Midas, but upgrading the Gold Total attribute and using the exit for the gold bonus will get you significantly more gold.

Till later,
André

notes.title: Update 97 - A slew of new Upgrades
notes.content:
Hi all,

We've added several new upgrades; here is a list of the changes:
[list]
[*]The upgrades book has separate pages for survivor levels. Upgrades for higher survivor levels cost more.
[*]Survivor level 2's new upgrades: Catch up, Weapon unlock speed, Status effect damage
[*]Survivor level 3's new upgrades: Damage to afflicted, Weapon storage, Artisan fee discount, Spawn at host
[*]Survivor level 4's new upgrades: Critical chance, Gold total, Exp earned, Limit break damage
[*]There are more upgrades planned for the near future.
[*]A bug that caused the game to lag when joining another player's game and using Esc to exit, was fixed.
[*]When "next levelup choice" was pressed but no levelups existed on screen, an error was produced. This was fixed.
[/list]
Enjoy the new upgrades. Some of them are quite pricey, but keep in mind that not all of them are critical.

Till later,
André

notes.title: Update 96 - Upgrade screen revamp
notes.content:
Hi all,

The Upgrades "book" is now split into Survivor Levels. More upgrades will be added soon.

While typing in the Chat box, the keyboard method of selecting level ups (Q, E and SPACE) got activated too. This has been fixed.

Till later,
André

notes.title: Update 95: Keyboard controls for level up choices
notes.content:
Hi all,

It's now possible to choose your level ups using the keyboard.
These are the default keys, which you can change via Options => Controls.
Q - Next Level Up
SPACE - Select Level Up
E - Ban

You have to press Q at least once before using SPACE. The reason for this is that I don't want the white outline to always be on the first button. Players might be confused by it.

These buttons cannot be used for menu navigation or anything else.

Til later,
André

notes.title: Update 94 - Memory optimization
notes.content:
Hi all,

This update contains memory optimization (pooling and reusing of game objects) so the game will run smoother.
I've also removed the annoying "prisoners was released" message that appears every time a lever is used.

Till later,
André

notes.title: Update 93 - Change to Blood Moon map mode
notes.content:
Hi all,

Blood Moon mode felt a bit too easy so I modified it by increasing enemy movement rate by 25%. This makes it theoretically possible to achieve 20 thousand kills in a single run.
The Blood Moon effect when guardians appear won't increase movement rate unless the map mode is set to Blood Moon.

I've also color coded the potion names, loot material names and marble names when they are displayed in the chat window. This makes them easier to spot.

Till later,
André

notes.title: Update 92 - New map mode, Blood Moon
notes.content:
Hi all,

Imagine the Blood Moon effect, which appears when a guardian spawns, actually lasting throughout the entire map! That's exactly what the new map mode does. Technically it doubles the spawn rate of the normal attackers.
As usual, you have to unlock everything on a map to be able to use the new map mode.

We've also mirrored (flipped left-to-right) the unique and legendary crystals. This makes it easier for color blind players to know which crystals are worth their time.

Till later,
André

notes.title: Update 91 - Potions
notes.content:
Hi all,

We are finally ready to introduce potions. For now, potions only makes you invulnerable to one or more status effects.

Overview of update content:
[list]
[*]An artisan that sells potions was added. You need to be Survivor level 3 to buy the potions and level 4 to buy the stronger potions.
[*]The chat window now features a scrollbar and keeps 50 messages. If you keep your cursor over the scrollbar, new messages appearing won't scroll the window to the bottom.
[*]Some new achievements were added.
[*]The Lamia Sharpshooter in the Cursed Sands map now has less health, so it should be a lot easier to kill.
[/list]
How potions work:
[olist]
[*]Currently the only way to obtain potions is by visiting Cassie via the Workshop. Cassie is unlocked when you find her in the Cursed Sands map.
[*]She sells a variety of potions that require 2 materials each to brew.
[*]There's a normal and a strong version of each potion type, e.g. Antidote and Strong Antidote.
[*]The normal potion requires 1 Crystal Dust and the strong one requires a specific Crystal Shard.
[*]For the Fireproof potions, a new type of crystal shard is required, the Legendary Crystal Shard. It is mined like the other crystals but cannot be refined by the Gem Cutter yet.
[*]Every time you play, you have to select whether you want to take your potions into the map. It's a single tick box.
[*]If you have your potions in the map, the moment you suffer a status effect, you will automatically use 1 potion (the weakest required). The potion will immediately render you immune and it lasts until you exit.
[*]When you die alone or exit the map, the potions consumed are removed from your stash (1 for each type of status effect suffered).
[*]If you use Esc to exit, or you are disconnected, progress is not saved so your potions will not be affected either.
[*]It is not possible to store or sell potions.
[/olist]
I hope you find the potions useful. They don't cover all possible status effects yet, so more will be added in future.

Till later,
André

notes.title: Update 90 - Cosmetics and bugfixes
notes.content:
Hi all,

This small update contains the following:
[list]
[*]The Blood Moon effect does not disappear now when there's multiple guardians and one of them dies.
[*]When using both the Snake Staff and the Scroll of the Dead, the scroll did not summon skeletons as intended. This has been fixed.
[*]The map mode "Runners" is now displayed in color when joining maps and also in-game.
[*]The map mode "Runners" won't be shown as an option if you have not obtained the achievement for the map's completion.
[/list]
Till later,
André

notes.title: Update 89 - New map mode, "Runners"
notes.content:
Hi all,

I've added a new map mode to help players reach level 200.
It work the same as the "Rush" mode, you have to get the achievement for completing the map.
Enemies now rush toward you at double their normal movement speed!
As long as you can keep them at bay, you won't have a shortage of exp crystals.

Note that this map mode is perhaps not suited for slow internet connections.

Till later,
André

notes.title: Update 88 - Addressing network lag
notes.content:
Hi all,

I've made changes to address the network lag. Hopefully this will be enough to ensure that the game runs smoother for players connecting.
If you often experienced this issue, please let me know if this update helped.
I can usually be found in the Revolt Discord https://discord.gg/X68f8hf2


Till later,
André

notes.title: Update 87 - More artisans, character attribute levelling and a new marble type
notes.content:
Hi all,

This update contains the following changes:
[list]
[*]Mortimer and an unknown black market trader can be found in the workshop. For now they only have one deal each, more deals will be added.
[*]You require Survivor Level 3 to trade the new marble type. It adds 7% damage per marble but enhancing is risky...
[*]Each character now has a Primary and Secondary attribute that's initially set to 10% and 5%. Some characters don't have a Secondary attribute and the percentage can also be lower.
[*]The Primary and Secondary attributes can be levelled - Primary can go from 10 to 20% and Secondary from 5% to 10%. In order to get the highest value you need to reach level 200. It's calculated as follows: Primary is normally level x 0.1 and Secondary is level x 0.05
[/list]
For those of you who have Survivor level 3, good luck getting your best weapons to +21%

Till later,
André

notes.title: Update 86 - Network data changes
notes.content:
Hi all,

We've changed the networking to split large data packets into 2 parts.
This has a slight performance impact, but helps to prevent lag and disconnects.

Large network packets are sometimes discarded on the internet. There's various reasons for this, from settings on a firewall, ISP software or physical router settings.

I hope this change will reduce the number of disconnects, especially for players that often suffer this fate.

Till later,
André

notes.title: Update 85 - Status effect damage included in damage-over-time
notes.content:
Hi all,

Status effect damage is now included in a weapon's damage-over-time calculations. The effect of this is explained below.
[list]
[*]It will now be easier to unlock weapons that deal purely status effect damage.
[*]The damage shown below the weapon icons and in the player's portrait now includes damage from status effects.
[*]Life Steal now also works from status effect damage, greatly increasing it's effectiveness.
[/list]
Overall I found that my damage displayed increased by 20%, using weapons like the frost bow, dynamite, lightning coil staff  and cyclone staff.

Till later,
André

notes.title: Update 84 - Dynamite now causes shatter effect on frozen enemies
notes.content:
Hi all,

There are now 2 weapons that can shatter frozen enemies, the ball bomb and dynamite.
Dynamite no longer sets enemies on fire. This is to prevent the ice from thawing and preventing the shatter effect.

I recommend using the cyclone staff, frost bow and dynamite together for a fast kill rate.
Status effect damage (e.g. shatter, freeze, burn and shock) is still not added to the player's DPS but we are checking whether this is possible.

Till later,
André

notes.title: Update 83 - QOL and fixes
notes.content:
Hi all,

This update contains the following:
[list]
[*]The crystalizers can be filled with a single click. The button only appears when you have enough crystal dust to fill all available slots.
[*]The cyclone staff's status area effect (wet) can now target enemies closer to the player.
[*]The lamia sharpshooter in Cursed Sands now does slightly less damage and has a slightly shorter range.
[*]Removed the "wood chop" sound that appeared when the exit was activated.
[*]An error occurred when all chests were opened while the hireling Guide was used. The error caused the game to slow down.
[/list]
Note that the "Tomb Raider" achievement requires the SAME player to destroy 20 sarcophagi.

Till later,
André

notes.title: Update 82 - Improved health regeneration
notes.content:
Hi all,

This is a technical update that smooths health regeneration, helping players survive.
It used to be calculated as an integer amount once every 2 seconds. Now it's stored as a fraction and calculated once every second.

Till later,
André

notes.title: Update 81 - New map, characters and equipment
notes.content:
Hi all,

This is quite a big update so let's dive straight into the details:
[list]
[*]A new map, Cursed Sands is introduced and it has a desert theme. It has the highest difficulty level but also the highest marble drop chance.
[*]The new map is unlocked by using the exit in the cemetery in Castle Ruins.
[*]Two new playable characters are introduced.
[*]Enemy spawners are introduced. They have to be destroyed for enemies to stop spawning.
[*]A map specific weapon, the cyclone staff, causes a water status effect area. Two other weapons are borrowed from Castle Ruins and used as placeholders for future weapons.
[*]There are three new armor sets to collect.
[*]There are also three new artifacts that fuse with the armor.
[*]A new status effect, rot, is deadlier than ordinary poison and lasts a lot longer.
[*]A new status effect, curse, turn enemies into snails. It does not change their hp or movement speed, only their resistances and weaknesses.
[*]Some new materials are introduced with the new enemies.
[*]Castle Ruins can now be completed to get the achievement.
[/list]
Have fun with the new map and characters.

Till later,
André

notes.title: Update 80 - Rare crystals are easier to find and other changes
notes.content:
Hi all,

We've increased the occurrence of rare crystals in the maps. Here is the list of changes included:
[list]
[*]Chances of finding yellow crystals doubled and purple crystals increased by 50% in all maps with crystals.
[*]In Sunken Caverns, instead of just one there are now two miners in the room nearest to the player's starting position.
[*]The exploding barrels now cause oil fire, which burns longer and does more damage.
[*]The two crystals that could not be mined in the Corrupted Forest were moved.
[*]In Castle Ruins, when the yellow guardian appears, the player character's light sometimes disappeared. This was fixed.
[*]A game using the Rush mode can now only be joined within the first 15 minutes of gameplay,
[*]Guardians now use a unique spawn sound.
[*]A bug causing disembodied status effects that could be seen in the bottom left corner of the Caves map was fixed.
[/list]
We've also added a reminder about the unofficial Discord server to the game's main menu.

Till later,
André

notes.title: Update 79 - Beginner equipment can now be sold or enhanced
notes.content:
Hi all,

You can now sell beginner equipment or, instead of selling the knife and the sling, enhance them with marbles!
[olist]
[*]All equipment can now be sold but a minimum amount has to remain available in the stash. A message will stop you from selling or storing equipment if not enough remain available.
[*]Two unstored weapons have to remain. Four armor pieces, one of each type have to remain. Six artifacts have to remain. These amounts ensure that all equipment slots are filled during gameplay.
[*]If your artifact fuses with your armor, you can have one artifact slot left open during play.
[*]When you filter on Materials in the Stash, the amount you own will be shown below each material.
[/olist]
Time to clean up your stash, enjoy!

Till later,
André

notes.title: Update 78 - Oil flask weapon and oil fire
notes.content:
Hi all,

We've added another map-specific weapon for Forest Dungeon, the oil flask. This bring the number of map-specific weapons to 3 for all the "big" maps.
We also spent a lot of time smoothing out movement of the Guardians, especially when they recover from status effects.
[list]
[*]New weapon Oil Flask has to be unlocked via damage over time in Forest Dungeon or Corrupted Forest maps. The Rush map mode won't be available for these maps until the new weapon has been unlocked.
[*]The "oily" status effect turns into "oil fire" when hit by fire. Oil fire does a lot more damage.
[*]Oil and water does not mix, so a "wet" status repels the "oily" status and vice versa.
[*]Made the gem cutter more useful by changing the chances of finding a gem or a marble to 20% each and crystal dust to 60%.
[*]Overall improvement of the visual effect of enemies being hit.
[/list]
We hope you enjoy the new weapon and find some interesting status effect synergies.

Till later,
André

notes.title: Update 77 - Map mode displayed in-game
notes.content:
Hi all,

Just a small update that shows the map mode in-game (bottom right corner).
The mode is not displayed if it's "normal".
The update also fixes the message that kept saying the artisan needs to rest.

Til later,
André

notes.title: Update 76 - Artisans
notes.content:
Hi all,

We've added artisans to the game. You unlock them when you buy a playable character, e.g. Brumik the gem cutter. Artisans normally perform a service for a fee but can also trade with you.

[list]
[*]Artisans can be found in the Workshop from the Character Selection screen.
[*]You can only see the Workshop icon once you reach Survivor level 3.
[*]Added Brumik the gem cutter who appraises crystals to produce marbles, crystal dust and gems. The chances of finding a marble or gem is 15% each, leaving 70% for finding crystal dust.
[*]Artisans have to take breaks to recuperate. Brumik can appraise 20 times before he's exhausted. He rests during gameplay time.
[*]Added a "sell 10" button to the Stash. Can be used to sell materials faster.
[*]Since Brumik was looking a bit lonely in the big workshop we also added Esme the material trader. She doesn't trade yet but we plan to complete that feature soon.
[*]Wording of the "Marble Madness" achievement was changed to indicate that it refers to dropped marbles.
[/list]
Note that gems, similar to marbles and crystal dust, cannot be sold.
Also, a quick reminder that the Miner hireling harvests crystals.
I hope you enjoy the artisans feature and happy crystal hunting!

Till later,
André

notes.title: Update 75 - Map modes
notes.content:
Hi all,

We are exited to announce Map Modes, applied by the host, that affects the map or enemies in some way. Our first map mode called "Rush" speeds up the spawning and decreases the playing time. It is recommended for players who can cope with the increased spawn rate and prefer a shorter gameplay experience.
[list]
[*]Rush mode increases the enemy spawn rate by 33% and decreases the time between "waves" by 33%. This means that the first guardian will spawn at 20 minutes.
[*]Rush mode can only be used when everything on the map has been unlocked. Players that don't have everything unlocked can still join.
[*]The map mode (Normal by default) is visible in the Join Game lobby.
[/list]
I hope you enjoy the Rush mode. Keep in mind that it's shortened (guardian at 20 instead of 30 minute mark) so it will be less optimal for players who still need to find chests or unlock map-specific weapons.

Till later,
André

notes.title: Update 74 - UI improvements and fixes
notes.content:
Hi all,

This update contains the following:
[list]
[*]When hovering over a weapon's upgrade options, the upgrade type's description will be displayed. This is to help beginners understand what the upgrade does.
[*]When the Phoenix Egg artifact was used and later dropped, the amount of Revives available became negative (but displayed as 256 + negative value). This has been fixed.
[*]The arrow above the player's character now looks different from the ones above the followers & hirelings.
[*]The minecart's hp bar was moved to below it.
[*]"Pooling" of Loot objects has been implemented on the client, resulting in a small performance increase.
[/list]
Till later,
André

notes.title: Update 73 - Hireling & follower damage
notes.content:
Hi all,

This small update contains the following:

[list]
[*]The hirelings & followers do more damage as the player levels up. It was incorrectly based on the level of the player with the highest level instead of their owner.
[*]When a guardian spawns, the sky will turn red and enemies will spawn twice as fast! When it dies, the sky and spawn rate will return to normal. The 3rd guardian's appearance will still cause enemy spawns to stop.
[/list]
Till later,
André

notes.title: Update 72 - Various updates and fixes
notes.content:
Hi all,

This update contains the following:
[list]
[*]Lifesteal and health regeneration percentages were rounded down when displayed in-game (via clicking on the player's portrait). The percentages are now displaying as intended. Note that not all decimals are shown.
[*]The Sunken Caverns has 2 spawning points for captured dwarves. The one closest to the entrance will now always spawn a dwarf with a pickaxe. The other will still have either a dwarf with dynamite or one with a pickaxe. This is to make it easier to harvest the large crystals in the map.
[*]All the new materials except for the large crystals, are now sold for 1 coin each.
[*]Slimes are now immune to the bleed status.
[*]Small changes were made to the mini map (some units are now easier to see).
[*]Materials that drop from plants, whether by the hireling or the player, now has the same drop rate as items in clay post (60%). We will consider having the Drop Rate aura affect these drops (including clay pots).
[*]The herbalist adventurer can now harvest star flowers.
[/list]
We are aware that the hirelings seem to wander aimlessly at times and can move between trees where the players can't follow. Increasing Loot Distance will help and not picking up all of the materials is fine since they are not as scarce as the materials dropping from enemies.

Till later,
André

notes.title: Update 71 - Hire adventurers at the Tavern
notes.content:
Hi all,

This update is mostly about the adventurer hirelings, so let's dig into that first.

[list]
[*]Some of the followers you gain while playing will appear in the Tavern, offering their services for hire.
[*]In order to have the adventurer appear in the Tavern, they have to be a follower of you when you leave via the portal or exit.

notes.title: Update 64 - Auras
notes.content:
Hi all,

We are excited to announce a new feature that enhances the co-op experience and makes playable characters more unique. Here is everything you need to know about Auras:

[list]
[*]You start getting Aura lines from Survivor level 2 to 4, for a total of 3 lines per playable character.
[*]While playing, it affects all players and you don't have to be a minimum distance from each other.
[*]Every character has it's own set of auras that can be re-rolled for 200 gold. There's no limit to the number of times it can be re-rolled.
[*]When re-rolling auras you can first lock the ones you don't want to change. Locking is done with marbles, that gets turned to crystal dust with the re-roll.
[*]A rare marble locks the 1st line, an epic marble the 2nd and a unique marble the 3rd.
[*]Aura stacking: If only one player has a specific aura, everyone gets 8%, but if more players have it, everyone gets an additional 4% per player.
[*]Almost all auras stack, e.g. if you have a Critical Damage +8% aura and play with 3 other players that have the same, the total will be 8% + 4% + 4% + 4% = 20%
[*]Some auras, like Weapon Unlock Speed +50%, does not stack but already has a big value.
[*]When players join or leave, their auras will be added or removed from all other players.
[*]Aura lines contain 10 unique aura types per line and these types don't overlap.
[*]When you re-roll, you have a 1 out of 9 chance to get a specific aura, since the current one won't be rolled again.
[/list]
Other changes:
[list]
[*]A bug was fixed that prevented the Upgraded values of Collision Size and Area of Effect from working correctly in-game. It may now seem as if you are hitting enemies without even touching them, since these areas can be quite large.
[*]The Wooden Chest is now easier to distinguish from the Gold Chest.
[*]Attackers and guards won't spawn around dead players anymore.
[/list]
Since there's finally a good use for all that gold you've stored up, what are you waiting for?

Till later,

notes.title: Update 28 - Attribute calculation changes
notes.content:
Hi,

We revised the calculation of the following attributes:
[list]
[*]Regenerate Health
[*]Absorb Damage
[*]Lifesteal
[*]Critical Chance
[*]Elemental Resistance
[*]Attack Cooldown
[/list]
The calculation was changed so that the attribute values cannot exceed 1 (displayed as 100%).
This is important because we often add more equipment or other sources of these attributes and it's a struggle to keep the total below 1.

The calculation used to work like this:
Total = percentage1 + percentage2 + percentage3
e.g. 0.6 + 0.3 + 0.1 = 1 

Now it works like this:
Total = 1 - (1 - percentage1) * (1 - percentage2) * (1 - percentage3)
e.g. 1 - (1 - 0.6) * (1 - 0.3) * (1 - 0.1)
= 1 - 0.4 * 0.7 * 0.9
= 0.748

Till later,
André

notes.title: Update 27 - A stray dog will help you survive
notes.content:
Hi,

We've added a stray dog to the Castle Ruins map.
It's to the north of the portal in the sewer.
The dog will fight alongside you but will disappear when you leave the map.

Let us know if you enjoy this new feature :-)

Till later,
André

notes.title: Update 26 - Cash in on Achievements!
notes.content:
Hi,

We've added the Achievements screen where you can claim gold for all your achievements!
There are over 50 achievements but we plan on adding more.

We also improved the animation of the knife and dagger attacks.

Till later,
André

notes.title: Update 25 - Will that puddle damage me?
notes.content:
Hi,

This update contains some eagerly awaited QOL improvements.
[list]
[*]Puddles, e.g. poison, fire & acid, will have an outline in the player's color. If there's no outline, it's dangerous.
[*]The Shop button in the main menu will have a number indicating how many new items arrived. Note that, if you sell something from the Stash, it's added to the number on the button. If there's more than 9 new items, a "+" will be shown.
[*]Mini bosses now have a yellow light surrounding them to make them more visible.
[*]Pressing "T" in-game will switch the game tips on or off and actually remember this setting, even if you exit the game.
[/list]
Till later,
André

notes.title: Update 24 - Miniboss spawn fix
notes.content:
Hi,

The update contains a fix for the miniboss spawn rate, that was lowered by mistake.
It also contains improvements to the reliability of data sent back from the players to the host.
This should solve a rare issue where the host did not receive the level up choice made by the player.

Till later,
André

notes.title: Update 23 - Some sounds are now location based and fade with distance
notes.content:
Hi,

Some sounds (mostly attacks and hits) are now location based and also fade with distance.
The maximum "hearing range" is about 1.5 X the screen's width.

Till later,
André

notes.title: Update 22 - Fix lag caused by bola and sling hitting the same enemy
notes.content:
Hi,

I'm very grateful for everyone that pointed out this issue.
It's now been resolved.

Till later,
André

notes.title: Update 21 - Remove progress indication from weapon after unlocking
notes.content:
Hi,

I noticed that weapons are still looking "greyed out" after getting unlocked via damage.
The grey progress indication is now removed after you select the unlock,

Till later,
André

notes.title: Update 20 - Arrows above players and prioritising weapon unlocks
notes.content:
Hi,

Here are the improvements contained in this update:
[list]
[*]There are now arrows above players, using the same colors as their portraits.
[*]When you unlock a weapon via damage, it will now give you a level so you can claim it immediately.
[*]The game now tries to keep the number of enemies as close to 100 as possible, despawning the ones furthest away from their targets.
[*]Electrocute is now visible on enemies and does more damage than shock. It's triggered when a target has both water and lightning status effects.
[/list]
Till later,
André

notes.title: Update 19 - Showing Portal & Exit on mini map and some network tuning
notes.content:
Hi,

The update contains a few changes.
[list]
[*]The portal and exit is now visible on the mini map.
[*]There was a small possibility of spawning inside a portal pillar and not being able to move.
[*]We also made changes to exp crystals to improve the network performance.
[/list]
Till later,
André

notes.title: Update 18 - New map and equipment!
notes.content:
Hi,

Today we're exited to announce the new map and other new content.
[list]
[*]You escape from the sewers, but find a dilapidated castle, filled with bandits.
[*]If you move through the cemetery grounds, a second set of enemies will spawn.
[*]The map contains 3 new weapons, 3 armor sets, 2 artifacts and a new character, the alchemist.
[*]The alchemist has a unique primary and secondary weapon.
[*]A new artifact, Rage, gives you a Limit Break Damage bonus.
[*]The Golden Armor set gives you bonus gold when you escape. It fuses with Gheed's Coin.
[*]The Dwarven Armor set fuses with the Resistance ring to give Elemental Resistance.
[*]The Black Leather set fuses with the Feather to give Movement speed.
[/list]

Other changes:
[list]
[*]For the first 3 minutes, enemies will now spawn slower, making it easier to start and also easier for someone that joins your game.
[*]For a fun way to find the names of the enemies, just get killed by one in a co-op game.
[*]It's now easier to see what color you've selected for a character.
[*]After 30 minutes of gameplay, a warning message will appear when a Guardian spawns.
[*]The status effect "acid" was added to the game.
[/list]

I hope you'll enjoy the new map.

Till later,
André

notes.title: Update 17 - Guards despawning and Limit Break Damage attribute
notes.content:
Hi,

This is another small update as we get closer to the bigger content release.

[list]
[*]Limit Break Damage is a new player attribute that increases the damage of your primary and secondary weapon during Limit Break. It cannot be upgraded but will soon be available on a new artifact.
[*]Guard enemies will now despawn if you move far away, but respawn if you go back to where they came from. The number of enemies were going way over 200, causing networking issues.
[*]Fixed a problem causing the guardians' health bars to become too large.
[*]Fixed a problem where the boomerang, familiar and water sprite did not show hit animations when they hit their targets.
[*]The flintlock, cannon and ball bomb's sounds were revised.
[*]Particle effects were added to the exit.
[/list]
Till later,
André

notes.title: Update 16 - Armor weight changes
notes.content:
Hi,

We picked up an issue with armor weight causing ridiculous high Damage Absorption values (over 100% of damage!).
The absorption percentages were changed to:
Light - 6% per piece (4 pieces or 5 if you fuse with an artifact)
Medium - 9% per piece (4 pieces or 5 if you fuse with an artifact)
Light - 12% per piece (4 pieces or 5 if you fuse with an artifact)

Movement Speed and Attack Cooldown penalties were removed from the equation, so the weight of the armor no longer affects your movement or attack speed!

Fixed Griffo the hunter starting with Claws instead of the Javelin as primary weapon.

Work on the new content has entered the testing phase.

Till later,
André

notes.title: Update 15 - New player ability
notes.content:
Hi,

We are releasing another small update but we are almost done with a bigger update that contains a lot of new content.

[list]
[*]A new player ability, Limit Break Duration was added. It can be upgraded and it increases the duration of limit break.
[*]The day & night transition is now much smoother. Time of day on the client and host can become out of sync but this won't affect the gameplay.
[*]Status effect areas are now slightly smaller and more easily avoided.
[*]Ordered equipment first by type and next by name in the Shop and Stash.
[*]Equipment in the Shop and the Stash now say where you found them. This is useful when looking for missing pieces of an armor set.
[*]Fixed movement of character when pressing W, A, S or D while chatting.
[*]If you already have the exit key, enemies won't drop it. (in a multiplayer game is could still drop if other players don't have it)
[/list]

Let us know if you've created a video, it's always interesting to see new strategies :-)

Till later,
André

notes.title: Update 14 - Status effect kills
notes.content:
Hi,

There's quite a few changes in this update.
[list]
[*]Status effects now do double the damage to enemies. Damage to players remain the same.
[*]The flintlock pistol was given a significant boost and it can now shoot through enemies, hitting up to 4 at a time!
[*]Critical hits now do at least double damage!
[*]Enemies that die from status effects (e.g. fire) that was caused by a player, will now be added to that player's kills.
[*]If an enemy was standing right on top of you, some weapons did not fire. This was fixed.
[*]If you stand still for a few seconds, enemies will start spawning in all directions around you. Previously they always spawned in the last direction moved.
[*]Exp crystals were modified for better stacking. The cyan crystals were added.
[*]Some weapons were rebalanced. A few of the less powerful weapons were given a boost.
[/list]

Till later,
André

notes.title: Update 13 - A mixed bag
notes.content:
Hi,

We have made the following changes:
[list]
[*]You will see "quick start" tips when entering a map. This is for beginners and can be disabled.
[*]Beefed up the health regeneration on a character when entering a map.
[*]Enemy health bars become visible only after they've taken 10% damage, except for mini bosses.
[*]Prevent players joining a game that's already ended.
[*]Prevent players joining a game that's already running for 25 minutes, else the portal is disabled past the 30 minute mark.
[*]Some maps unlocked when you used the portal to escape. This has been fixed.
[*]The Refund button stayed visible when leaving and re-entering the Upgrade screen.
[/list]

Till later,
André

notes.title: Update 12 - Refund your upgrades
notes.content:
Hi,

You can now refund all your player ability upgrades. It's done per ability and there is no gold penalty.

When connecting to another player for a co-op game, you will now receive a proper error message when the connection cannot be made.
The errors are related to the maximum number of players, the game's version numbers and other rare events, e.g. when the host exits while you are connecting.

I still need to add something to prevent a player from joining after 25 minutes of gameplay. This will ensure that the Portal does not power down when you need to escape!

Till later,
André

notes.title: Update 11 - Enemy health scaling and brighter clothes
notes.content:
Hi,

We've slightly increased enemy health scaling, meaning that they can overwhelm players a little earlier than before.
For beginner players, the best strategy is to start playing with Nokk and find some gold or unlock some equipment before playing with Ivar.

Bright colors still looked dull on most of the characters, so we increased the brightness of the clothes for a better effect.

When using a Revive or when rescued, surrounding enemies are now knocked back.

Till later,
André

notes.title: Update 10 - Color my amazed
notes.content:
Hi,

Firstly, if you join another player's game or someone joins yours and the game behaves strangely, it's probably because both players have not updated their game.
The version of the game is visible on the main screen.

We added the ability to change the color of a character's clothes.
Only certain parts (usually fabric) can be changed.
At the moment, if you don't choose a color, the outfit will be gray.

The sling's stun effect is now less effective and won't work against most of the mini bosses and strong enemies anymore.
The same goes for the bola's immobilize effect, but it's still more effective than the sling.
It didn't make sense to have these weapons prevent the strongest enemies from moving.

In a multiplayer game, the arrows indicating the direction of other players have been paired with the same color visible on a character's health bar.

The 3 guardians at the 30 min mark has been reworked to ensure that only 1 of each types spawn and there are 2 minutes between spawns.

Till later,
André

notes.title: Update 9 - Sell your trinkets
notes.content:
Hi,

We've added a Stash where you can view all your existing equipment.
It looks similar to the shop, except that you can sell an item for 75% of its purchase value.
This will help you get rid of equipment that you don't like.

Equipment that you start out with, e.g. the silk armor and lantern, cannot be sold.
We've also added 2 starter weapons, the knife and the sling, which cannot be sold.

The elf's sprite has been reworked.

The new weapon, a sling, can stun enemies.

The bola was changed so it can hit and ensnare up to 3 enemies at a time.

If you experience problems in a multiplayer game, please check if you are using the same version of the game. The version is on the main screen. We will add an automatic check for this in the near future.

Till later,
André

notes.title: Update 8 - Touching on end of map guardians
notes.content:
Hi,

I've noticed that not all maps spawn the guardians at the end.
I've adjusted the timing, so 3 types should spawn now.
Each of them drop slightly better loot (I won't spoil it by saying), but they are extremely difficult to kill.

Till later,
André

notes.title: Update 7 - Show number of unopened chests next to mini map
notes.content:
Hi,

We added the number of unopened chests next to the mini map. Now you can see if you've opened all the chests.

We also improved the maul (weapon) by making it easier to hit enemies. The greataxe (barbarian's main weapon) was balanced again.

If a chest's content is lying on the ground, the mini map did not show it. It now looks like an unopened chest on the mini map.

Till later,
André

notes.title: Update 6 - Nokk gets a boost and pots get trampled
notes.content:
Hi,

We've reworked the two axes and swords so they hit enemies more easily.
We also increased the number of enemies they can hit but at the cost of some damage.
Nokk (barbarian) is probably now the easier character to start with.

You can now step on pots and chests to break them.

Arrows indicating the direction of other players are now easier to see.

Till later,
André

notes.title: Update 5 - Exp crystal stacking
notes.content:
Hi,

Exp crystals drop at an alarming rate, so we've made them combine if they fall on the same spot.
They change from single shards to crystal clumps as their value grows.
Their colors also go from blue to yellow, green and red.
When they cant combine anymore, they still stack on top of each other.

Since the number of crystals are now reduced, I've doubled the time before they despawn.
Chest contents and the exit key will never despawn if they drop.
Gold and food will despawn after 10 minutes.

We also put back the scuttlers (spiders) that we accidentally removed.

Till later,
André

notes.title: Update 4 - Friendlier fire
notes.content:
Hi,

Fire bombs found in the 3rd map set their owners (and friends) on fire too! This has been fixed.
The poison pools created by enemies and pots are still deadly.

I fixed the annoying sound that played when exiting via the portal.

Till later,
André

notes.title: Update 3 - First chest you open will always give an unlock
notes.content:
Hi,

Considering the difficulty curve of the game I've decided to make it easier to unlock equipment.

If you have not found all the equipment in a map, you will always find one in the first chest you open.
Equipment found in the chests are:
[b]Wooden chest[/b]: armor
[b]Silver chest[/b]: artifact else armor
[b]Gold chest[/b]: secondary weapon else character else artifact else armor

Subsequent chests will work like usual, containing an equip, the exit key or just gold.

If you only have characters left to find in a map, opening wooden and silver chests won't help.

Some players will just open one chest then exit or work in groups, opening one chest each.
This is a viable strategy but it won't shower you with gold.

Till later,
André

notes.title: Update 1 - Prevent entering players from immediately ending a session
notes.content:
Hi,

This announcement ended up not being posted, apologies for the delay.

When deciding on this change I took into consideration the fact that this is a co-op game and that the option to play with your friends in a private session exists.

Players that enter a session will now cause the portal to restart charging for 5 minutes before it can be used to end the session.

This has solved the issue of players joining and accidentally ending the session by not moving away from the portal.

Till later,
André

notes.title: Update 2 - Making forests easier to cross
notes.content:
Hi,

Trees are now easier to travel through (tree stumps are thinner but still block movement).
The Limit Break activation now knocks back enemies around the character!

Till later,
André
